title: HR Executive
description:
* An HR Executive manages daily human resources operations, including recruitment, employee relations, payroll coordination, and policy implementation.
* They serve as a primary link between management and staff to ensure a productive, legally compliant, and positive workplace environment.
* Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment and Onboarding: Source candidates, screen resumes, schedule interviews, issue offers, and run induction programs for new hires.
* Employee Relations: Handle day\-to\-day staff grievances, resolve workplace conflicts, and support employee engagement activities.
* Payroll and Benefits: Coordinate payroll inputs, track attendance and leaves, and assist with benefits administration.
* Compliance and Records: Maintain accurate employee databases and ensure adherence to local labor laws and company regulations.
* Performance Support: Assist with performance appraisal cycles, goal\-setting reviews, and exit interviews.
* Tamil candidates only
* Chennai Candidates and Freshers only.

Pay: ₹11,015\.05 \- ₹33,101\.19 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.

title: Senior Manager - Compensation & Benefits
description:
Designation: Senior Manager


Location: India Maharashtra Indiabulls Ho\-mumbai


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


Support and execute compensation and benefits initiatives such as market surveys, compensation benchmarking, benefits plans, Performance Management System, payroll and other employee payout inputs, generation of MIS reports, repository creation of all JDs/KPI/KRA, audit needs, thus ensuring compensation \& benefits plans are executed seamlessly across all business units viz ABML, ABIF, ABARC.

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Job Context/Job Challenges:  

Aditya Birla Money Limited (ABML) is primarily a Broking Company, deals in Equity, Commodity \& Currency. Workforce of \~800 spread across \~40 locations with customer base of in excess of 3 lacs. Commodity operations are managed through its 100% subsidiary Aditya Birla Commodities Broking limited. ABML is one of the leading securities trading companies in the country. ABML operates in a fragmented equity broking business and has a daily turnover of close to 3,000 Crores with a market share of 1%. ABM works in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating its day to day operations. In addition to the regulator ABML is also subject to close monitoring and inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX / NSDL / CDSL etc. ABML also operates in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of local broking outfits.
  

The Human Resources department manages the entire gamut of employee management and employee development activities for ABMML, ABML and ABCSPL. This includes Talent Acquisition, Training \& Development, Compensation \& performance management \& HR Statutory Compliance.  

  

The position is currently responsible for Three companies \-Aditya Birla Money Ltd, Aditya Birla Infrastructure Finance Ltd \& Aditya Birla Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd. These companies form part of the Aditya Birla Capitals core business and integral to the growth plan of ABCap.  

  

The Chief Manager \-Comp. \& Benefits, supports the C\&B function and will support the business on all compensation, remuneration and benefit related topics.
  

  

The major challenges in this role are:  

Providing analysis and accurate data inputs in short timeframes within defined timelines  

Ensure strategic plans with respect to compensation initiatives and benefits plans are executed seamlessly  

Support in managing compensation and benefits programs in alignment with the ABCap Compensation architecture.

#### **Key Result Areas**

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs Ensure timely updation \& generation of changes in salary annexures as and when due.  

Liaise with payroll team for timely processing of various employee payout inputs.  


KRA2 Execute the Annual Performance Management process with respect to data analyses in line with budgets \& the proposal finalisation document as per given timelines Analyse performance ratings, normal distribution curve and promotion recommendations  

Provide regular update on the rating summary pre / post performance appraisal to the Functional Heads  

Review employee records and ensure that information is uploaded on the Poornata system within defined TATs  


KRA3 Provide MIS \& Analytics periodically on compensation and benefits utilization \& ensure controls and Data Management Support in the analysis of benefits utilization/ cash out trends/business performance (budgets vs actuals)  

Support in the analysis of comp \& ben costing with respect to Manpower budgets for the year.  

Provide periodic \& standardised reports on Goal setting, PMS completion, etc  

Provide dashboard on various C\&B related analysis  

Provide and ensure quick availability for basic C\&B data and various analytics to aid in making right and informed decision w.r.t. C\&B and HR policies  

Ensure employee data is recorded accurately on Poornata system  


KRA4 Handle Compensation Helpdesk to support and close employee queries Close all employee queries within TAT, especially during special initiatives and performance review cycles.  

Analyse the trend in the inflow of queries, arrive at FAQs for repeat queries  

Proactively help in closing requirements related to repeat queries by sharing information to hr help desk  


KRA5 Ensure smooth management of Poornata System for the organisation to ensure that employee records are maintained and updated in a timely manner Ensure adequate documentation and updation of JDs/KPI/KRA for all the roles in the organization and their validity against goal settings of the respective incumbents.  

Collaborate on periodic information audits  

Ensure efficient data management on Poornata System pertaining to employee records

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description – Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain**

**Role Overview**

The Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain will be responsible for managing Snackit’s Direct Supplies business along with product planning, procurement coordination, inventory, stock movement, expiry management, client requirements, pricing, margins, and business growth.

The role will involve managing the complete product lifecycle — from understanding client requirements and selecting the right products and brands, to procurement, stock planning, allocation, supply, monitoring product performance, controlling expiry and wastage, and ensuring profitable business growth.

The person will work closely with clients, suppliers, procurement, operations, finance, and internal teams to ensure the right product is available at the right location, at the right time, and at the right cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Product Management**

* Manage Snackit’s product portfolio across vending and Direct Supplies categories.
* Understand customer and client requirements and identify suitable products.
* Identify new products, brands, and categories based on market demand and client requirements.
* Develop and maintain the right product mix for different client locations.
* Identify high\-margin products and brands and drive their adoption where commercially suitable.
* Monitor product sales, demand, margins, and performance.
* Identify slow\-moving, low\-margin, and non\-performing products and take corrective action.
* Review product pricing regularly based on purchase cost, market conditions, client expectations, and target margins.
* Introduce new products and remove products that are not commercially viable.
* Work with suppliers and brands to improve product availability, pricing, schemes, and commercial terms.

**2\. Direct Supplies Management**

* Manage the complete Direct Supplies business for Snackit.
* Understand requirements of existing clients and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Meet new and existing clients to understand their pantry, snack, beverage, and other workplace supply requirements.
* Prepare product proposals and commercial quotations based on client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, discounts, margins, and commercial terms with clients.
* Ensure that client requirements are fulfilled accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Develop long\-term client relationships and increase repeat business.
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities.
* Expand the range of products supplied to existing clients.
* Develop new business opportunities and contribute to Direct Supplies revenue growth.

**3\. Demand Planning \& Stock Planning**

* Forecast product requirements based on historical consumption, current orders, client requirements, and expected demand.
* Plan stock requirements for different client locations.
* Ensure adequate stock availability without unnecessary overstocking.
* Determine minimum and maximum stock levels for key products.
* Plan replenishment based on consumption and lead time.
* Monitor demand fluctuations and adjust stock plans accordingly.
* Coordinate with procurement and operations teams to ensure timely replenishment.
* Ensure stock is available at the right location based on actual business requirements.

**4\. Inventory Management**

* Monitor overall inventory levels across Snackit locations.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure proper stock tracking.
* Monitor fast\-moving, slow\-moving, and non\-moving inventory.
* Identify excess stock and plan movement or utilization to avoid inventory blockage.
* Monitor stock ageing and take timely action on ageing inventory.
* Plan stock transfers between locations based on demand.
* Ensure inventory is aligned with expected sales and client requirements.
* Minimize inventory holding costs while maintaining required service levels.

**5\. Expiry \& Wastage Management**

* Take ownership of product expiry management across all Direct Supplies and relevant inventory.
* Monitor expiry dates regularly and maintain an expiry tracking system.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable.
* Identify products approaching expiry and take timely action.
* Plan stock movement between locations based on expiry and demand.
* Prioritize products with shorter shelf life for consumption or supply.
* Coordinate with operations and clients to reduce expiry\-related losses.
* Analyse expiry and wastage trends and implement corrective measures.
* Minimize product expiry, damage, wastage, and inventory losses.

**6\. Supply Chain \& Procurement Coordination**

* Coordinate the complete supply chain from supplier to client/location.
* Work with procurement teams to ensure products are purchased at competitive prices.
* Plan purchases based on demand, stock levels, lead times, and client requirements.
* Coordinate with suppliers regarding availability, pricing, delivery schedules, schemes, and replacement of damaged/expired products where applicable.
* Identify alternate suppliers when required.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs and commercial terms.
* Ensure timely movement of products from warehouse/supplier to required locations.
* Identify supply\-chain gaps and recommend improvements.

**7\. Margin \& Commercial Management**

* Maintain target margins across products and clients.
* Analyse product\-wise and client\-wise profitability.
* Evaluate the impact of discounts before offering commercial terms to clients.
* Negotiate with clients to achieve commercially viable pricing.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs.
* Identify opportunities to improve gross margin through better product selection, pricing, supplier negotiations, and product mix.
* Monitor products with low or negative margins and take corrective action.
* Ensure business growth does not compromise profitability.

**8\. Client Relationship \& Requirement Management**

* Meet existing and potential clients regularly.
* Understand their current and future product requirements.
* Identify gaps in their existing pantry/supply arrangements.
* Recommend products and solutions based on their consumption and requirements.
* Maintain strong relationships with key client contacts.
* Ensure client issues related to products, pricing, availability, and fulfilment are resolved promptly.
* Collect client feedback and use it to improve Snackit’s product and supply offering.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are properly communicated to internal teams.

**9\. Vending \& Direct Supplies Integration**

* Identify opportunities to combine Snackit’s vending\-machine services with Direct Supplies.
* Analyse consumption at vending locations and identify additional products that can be supplied directly to clients.
* Use vending\-machine sales and consumption data to support product and demand planning.
* Identify products that can be introduced across vending and direct\-supply channels.
* Coordinate with vending operations to ensure product availability and efficient stock utilization.
* Develop integrated food, beverage, and pantry solutions for clients.

**10\. Product Performance \& Business Analysis**

* Monitor product\-wise sales, margins, demand, inventory, and expiry.
* Analyse which products and brands are performing well and which are not.
* Track client\-wise revenue and profitability.
* Identify trends in customer consumption.
* Use data to make decisions regarding product selection, pricing, stock levels, and procurement.
* Prepare regular reports for management covering sales, margins, inventory, expiry, and business growth.
* Recommend actions based on business and operational data.

**11\. Process Improvement**

* Develop and improve processes for product selection, procurement, stock planning, inventory tracking, expiry management, and client fulfilment.
* Create systems to improve visibility of stock, demand, expiry, and product profitability.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions.
* Improve coordination between sales, procurement, operations, finance, and clients.
* Build scalable processes as Snackit’s Direct Supplies business grows.

**End\-to\-End Ownership**

The person will be expected to take ownership of the complete cycle:

**Client Requirement → Product Selection → Supplier/Procurement → Pricing → Margin → Purchase Planning → Inventory → Stock Allocation → Supply → Expiry Management → Client Feedback → Repeat Business → Business Growth**

**Key KPIs**

* Direct Supplies revenue growth
* Gross margin and profitability
* New client acquisition
* Existing client revenue growth
* Client retention
* Product\-wise profitability
* High\-margin product growth
* Inventory turnover
* Stock availability
* Reduction in stock\-outs
* Reduction in excess and dead stock
* Reduction in expiry and wastage
* Purchase cost savings
* Supplier commercial improvements
* Order fulfilment efficiency
* Client satisfaction

**Ideal Candidate**

· 0–6 years of experience in product management, supply chain, FMCG, B2B sales, institutional sales, category management, procurement, or a related field. Freshers with strong interest in product management, supply chain, inventory, and business operations are also welcome to apply.

· Experience in FMCG, food \& beverage, pantry supplies, vending, hospitality, or corporate supply business is preferred.

· Strong understanding of inventory, demand planning, procurement, and supply\-chain processes.

· Strong commercial and margin\-management mindset.

· Good negotiation and client\-management skills.

· Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.

· Good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and reporting.

· Ability to work with multiple teams and manage end\-to\-end responsibilities.

· Willingness to meet clients and visit client locations when required.

· Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work independently.

**Ideal Mindset**

The ideal candidate should think beyond simply selling products.

They should understand:

**What does the client need?**  
**What should we supply?**  
**At what price should we buy?**  
**At what price should we sell?**  
**What margin will we make?**  
**How much stock should we maintain?**  
**Where should the stock be placed?**  
**How can we avoid expiry and wastage?**  
**How can we increase the business from the same client?**  
**How can we grow the business profitably?**

* Provident Fund

title: HR-adviseur
description:
Vacature tekst  
Samen werken aan goed werkgeverschap  


Een leidinggevende die vastloopt in een complexe casus. Een ploeg waarin verandering voor onrust zorgt. Of beleid dat in de praktijk nog niet goed werkt. Als HR\-adviseur breng jij helderheid en help je leidinggevenden om zorgvuldig én daadkrachtig te handelen.  


Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt wet\- en regelgeving naar oplossingen waarmee mensen daadwerkelijk verder kunnen. Zo draag je bij aan goed werkgeverschap en aan een organisatie waarin medewerkers veilig, gezond en met plezier kunnen werken.  


Wil jij met jouw HR\-expertise iedere dag zichtbaar verschil maken voor leidinggevenden en medewerkers binnen het cluster beroeps? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.  


HR\-adviseur  
28 uur per week  


Wat ga je doen?  


Als HR\-adviseur van het cluster beroeps sta je dicht bij de dagelijkse praktijk van de brandweer. Je bent een vaste gesprekspartner voor de clustermanager, vier kazernemanagers en drie ploegchefs vrijwillig. Je ondersteunt hen bij personele en organisatorische vraagstukken binnen hun kazernes. Wanneer een situatie ingewikkeld wordt, een ploeg in beweging is of nieuw beleid om een werkbare vertaling vraagt, breng jij overzicht en help je hen om weloverwogen keuzes te maken.  


Het ene moment begeleid je een kazernemanager bij een complexe verzuim\- of functioneringscasus. Even later denk je mee over teamontwikkeling, duurzame inzetbaarheid of de gevolgen van een organisatieverandering. Je luistert naar wat er speelt, weegt verschillende belangen en komt met een advies dat zorgvuldig én praktisch uitvoerbaar is.  


Doordat je zichtbaar en benaderbaar bent, bouw je sterke adviesrelaties op en herken je vroegtijdig waar ondersteuning nodig is. Je beweegt mee als dat kan, maar durft ook constructieve tegenspraak te bieden en duidelijk richting te geven als de situatie daarom vraagt. Daarbij houd je oog voor de medewerker, de leidinggevende(n) en het bredere organisatiebelang.  


Je kijkt ook verder dan de afzonderlijke adviesvraag. Signalen uit de praktijk gebruik je om beleid, processen en instrumenten te verbeteren. Zo help je niet alleen bij wat vandaag speelt, maar draag je ook bij aan goed werkgeverschap voor de toekomst.  


Concreet betekent dit dat je:  


leidinggevenden adviseert en coacht bij personele, organisatorische en arbeidsrechtelijke vraagstukken;  
wet\- en regelgeving, cao\-afspraken en M\&O\-beleid vertaalt naar een heldere en toepasbare aanpak;  
risico’s, knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden analyseert en omzet in concrete voorstellen;  
bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van beleid, verandertrajecten en organisatiebrede projecten;  
bewaakt dat beleid, kaders en instrumenten zorgvuldig en consistent worden toegepast;  
draagvlak creëert en met collega’s en andere betrokkenen werkt aan een professionele M\&O\-dienstverlening.  


Over de afdeling Mens \& Organisatie en Communicatie  


Binnen de afdeling Mens \& Organisatie en Communicatie werken collega’s vanuit M\&O Advies, de Personeels\- en Salarisadministratie en Communicatie samen aan een toekomstbestendige organisatie. Vanuit verschillende expertises ondersteunen we de organisatie bij vraagstukken op het gebied van mens, organisatie en ontwikkeling.  


Als HR\-adviseur maak je deel uit van het team M\&O Advies. Je hebt een eigen aandachtsgebied, maar staat er niet alleen voor. Collega’s delen hun kennis, zoeken elkaar gemakkelijk op en pakken complexe of organisatiebrede vraagstukken samen op. Je krijgt ruimte om initiatief te nemen, je vakmanschap verder te ontwikkelen en invloed uit te oefenen op onze manier van werken.  


De afdeling speelt een actieve rol bij thema’s als goed werkgeverschap, duurzame inzetbaarheid, sociale veiligheid, diversiteit en inclusie. De sfeer is open, betrokken en informeel. We werken serieus aan onze opgaven en vinden collegialiteit, aandacht voor elkaar en werkplezier daarbij belangrijk.  


Wie ben jij?  


Een HR\-vraagstuk is zelden zwart\-wit. Belangen kunnen botsen, emoties lopen soms op en toch moet er een zorgvuldig besluit worden genomen. Juist op zulke momenten kom jij tot je recht. Met rust, aandacht en een scherpe analyse breng je terug wat er werkelijk speelt.  


Luisteren, doorvragen en verschillende perspectieven verbinden gaan voor jou vanzelf samen. Leidinggevenden en medewerkers vinden in jou een toegankelijke gesprekspartner, maar ook iemand die onafhankelijk blijft en duidelijk durft te adviseren. Geen oordeel op basis van de eerste indruk, maar een onderbouwde koers waarmee alle betrokkenen verder kunnen.  


Een organisatie in beweging past bij jou. Verandering betekent voor jou meer dan nieuwe afspraken op papier. Uiteindelijk moet het werken voor de mensen in de praktijk. Daarom neem je verantwoordelijkheid, zoek je actief de samenwerking op en houd je aandacht voor wat nodig is om van een besluit ook echt actie te maken.  


Wat breng je mee?  


hbo\-werk\- en \-denkniveau, bij voorkeur op het gebied van HRM, Personeel \& Arbeid of een vergelijkbare richting;  
meerdere jaren relevante ervaring als HR\- of M\&O\-adviseur binnen een complexe organisatie;  
actuele kennis van arbeidsrecht, cao\-afspraken en relevante wet\- en regelgeving;  
sterke adviesvaardigheden en het vermogen om je advies helder te onderbouwen;  
analytisch vermogen, organisatiesensitiviteit en een praktische aanpak;  
het vermogen om mensen en belangen met elkaar te verbinden.  


Kennis van of ervaring met een veiligheidsregio of een operationele 24\-uursorganisatie is een pre.  


Jouw motivatie  


We vragen je daarnaast om de onderstaande vragen afzonderlijk te beantwoorden. Je antwoorden maken deel uit van de eerste selectieronde. Als je de vragen niet of slechts gedeeltelijk beantwoordt, kunnen we je sollicitatie mogelijk niet zorgvuldig beoordelen.  


Beschrijf een complexe personele of organisatorische casus waarin jij als adviseur een belangrijke rol had. Wat was jouw aanpak, welke afwegingen maakte je en wat was het resultaat?  
Beschrijf een situatie waarin je als HR\-adviseur een adviesrelatie hebt opgebouwd met nieuwe leidinggevenden of binnen een nieuw organisatieonderdeel. Hoe heb je de verbinding gezocht, vertrouwen opgebouwd en zicht gekregen op wat er speelde? Wat heeft jouw aanpak opgeleverd voor de samenwerking en jouw advisering?  


Wat bieden wij jou?  


Naast werk met maatschappelijke impact bieden we je een mooie baan in een organisatie die 24/7 klaarstaat voor de regio. Je kunt rekenen op:  


een jaarcontract met de intentie om dit om te zetten in een vast dienstverband;  
een salaris van minimaal € 3\.843 ,\- tot maximaal € 5\.748 ,\- bruto per maand (schaal 10\) bij een 36\-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring;  
een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 18,63% van je jaarsalaris, dat je bijvoorbeeld kunt inzetten voor extra verlof of extra salaris;  
26 vakantiedagen bij een 36\-urige werkweek;  
pensioenopbouw bij ABP;  
een afwisselende werkomgeving, met een moderne werkplek in Leiden\-Zuid als uitvalsbasis. Om zichtbaar en dichtbij de praktijk te zijn, werk je ook regelmatig op de verschillende beroepskazernes in de regio. Als het werk dit toelaat, kun je deels thuiswerken;  
een laptop, telefoon en thuiswerkfaciliteiten;  
een vitaliteitsprogramma met onder meer korting op sport en vers fruit op het werk;  
ruimte en aandacht voor je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  


Over Veiligheidsregio Hollands Midden  


Samen met gemeenten, brandweer, GHOR, politie en andere partners zorgen we voor een veilige regio voor ruim 800\.000 inwoners. Met ongeveer 1\.400 betrokken collega’s werken we dagelijks aan het voorkomen en bestrijden van incidenten en crises.  


Meer informatie  


Wil je meer weten of heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met Letitia Apostolovic, Corporate Recruiter, via 06 39239125 of recruitment@vrhm.nl.  


Je bent welkom  


We willen een organisatie zijn waarin ruimte is voor verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en perspectieven. Denk je dat deze functie bij je past en voldoe je aan de functie\-eisen? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren. Bij ons draait het om wie je bent en wat je bijdraagt.  


Interesse?  


Wil jij met jouw advies bijdragen aan goed werkgeverschap binnen VRHM? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 2 september via de sollicitatieknop. De selectiegesprekken vinden plaats in de week 37\. Reserveer dit alvast in je agenda, zodat je hiermee rekening kunt houden als je wordt uitgenodigd.  


Overige informatie

We zoeken onze kandidaten graag zelf. Deze vacature is daarom geen uitnodiging tot acquisitie.

**Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for an HR Recruiter Intern to support our talent acquisition and hiring operations at CSK Technologies. You'll work closely with the Founder and the HR team to source candidates, screen applications, coordinate interviews, and keep our hiring pipeline moving — for both internal roles and ongoing recruitment drives.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, learning\-focused role for early\-career candidates who want real exposure to end\-to\-end recruitment in a fast\-moving digital company. You won't just observe — you'll actively source, screen, and coordinate. You'll also use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day to draft job descriptions, write outreach messages, and speed up screening.
   

  

 If you're a strong communicator who enjoys connecting with people and staying organized, this internship is for you.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Candidate Sourcing
   

  

* Search and shortlist candidates on LinkedIn, Naukri, Internshala, and other job portals.
* Build and maintain talent pools for current and upcoming roles.
* Post job openings across platforms and social media.


 Screening \& Coordination
   

  

* Review and screen incoming resumes and applications.
* Conduct initial qualification calls to assess fit and interest.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and the team.


 Pipeline \& Records
   

  

* Keep the applicant tracker / hiring sheet clean and up to date.
* Follow up with candidates at every stage and share timely updates.
* Maintain organized records of CVs, notes, and interview feedback.


 Employer Branding Support
   

  

* Help with recruitment posts, captions, and briefs for hiring creatives.
* Support a smooth candidate experience and prompt communication.


 AI\-Assisted Work
   

  

* Use Claude and ChatGPT to draft job descriptions, outreach messages, and screening questions.
* Use AI to speed up research, shortlisting, and documentation under guidance.


 Who Can Apply (Eligibility)
   

  

* Students in their final year or recent graduates (any discipline; HR / BBA / MBA a plus).
* Available to work on\-site in Noida Sector 62 for the full internship duration.
* Can commit to a minimum of 3 months, full\-time.
* No prior experience required — just strong communication and a willingness to learn.


**Required Skills**
* Confident communication in English and Hindi, written and spoken.
* Comfortable making calls and speaking with candidates.
* Good organizational skills and reliable follow\-up habits.
* Comfortable with LinkedIn, Google Sheets, Gmail, and Docs.
* Basic familiarity with Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI chatbot.


**Preferred (Good To Have)**
* Any prior recruitment, HR, or coordination experience.
* Familiarity with Naukri, Internshala, or LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Genuine interest in people, talent, and team building.


 What You Will Learn
   

  

* End\-to\-end recruitment — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing.
* How to write effective JDs and candidate outreach using AI tools.
* Professional communication, coordination, and stakeholder skills.
* How hiring really works inside a growing digital company.
* Modern recruitment tools and workflows (trackers, ATS, job portals).


 Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO) Opportunity
   

  

 High\-performing interns will be considered for a full\-time HR / Talent Acquisition role at CSK Technologies on successful completion of the internship — with a clear growth path into HR and People Operations.
   

  

 Internship Details

title: Solva Onboarding Coordinator
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**


Seco SOLVA is transforming manufacturing by going beyond cutting tools to deliver holistic, end\-to\-end solutions that improve efficiency, profitability, and competitiveness across the full production process. Built on Seco’s strong legacy, strategic partnerships, and innovative thinking, SOLVA helps manufacturers unlock their full potential through fast, easy, and sustainable solutions.


We are excited to welcome a Solva Onboarding Coordinator who can help create a smooth, consistent, and meaningful onboarding experience for colleagues joining our Business Development and Solva teams. This is a global role and can be based in any country.

**Job Summary:**  

As Solva Onboarding Coordinator, you will help new hires and internal transfers feel welcomed, prepared, and connected from day one. In this role, you will work closely with HR, leaders, and business stakeholders across regions to make sure each colleague has the information, tools, training, relationships, and follow\-up they need to contribute with confidence. The role may require international travel from time to time.

**Key responsibilities of the role:**

**Onboarding program management**

* Support the end\-to\-end onboarding journey for colleagues joining Business Development and Solva functions.
* Maintain clear onboarding roadmaps, checklists, and milestone plans from pre\-boarding through 30, 60, 90, and 180 days.
* Share clear onboarding updates with leaders and HR, including progress, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.

**New hire and transfer integration**

* Be a welcoming and practical point of contact for new hires and internal transfers during their initial onboarding period.
* Help create positive first connections through welcome communications, role introductions, stakeholder meetings, and functional orientation activities.
* Support both external hires and employees moving into new roles across Solva and Business Development.

**Cross\-functional coordination**

* Collaborate with HR, hiring managers, IT, L\&D, and business stakeholders to help ensure onboarding readiness before the start date.
* Ensure access, equipment, training assignments, onboarding sessions, and role\-specific materials are in place.
* Notice and raise any gaps or delays that may affect employee readiness or business continuity.

**Learning and capability enablement**

* Align role\-based onboarding content with Solva ways of working, tools, governance, process expectations, and customer journey understanding.
* Work together with the Solva L\&D / Upskilling Coordinator to connect onboarding with ongoing capability\-building programs.
* Keep onboarding materials current, accessible, and aligned with the evolving Solva operating model.

**Stakeholder connection and engagement**

* Coordinate buddy, mentor, or peer\-support assignments where relevant.
* Create inclusive opportunities for new colleagues to connect with Solva leaders, project teams, and subject matter experts.
* Listen to feedback from employees and hiring managers and turn their insights into practical onboarding improvements.

**Reporting and continuous improvement**

* Track onboarding completion, readiness milestones, feedback, and improvement actions.
* Prepare concise onboarding updates for HR and business stakeholders.
* Continuously improve templates, process flows, communication, and the overall onboarding experience.

**Required Competencies:**

**Skills and strengths we hope you bring**

* Experience in onboarding coordination, employee experience, or a related area.
* A structured approach to planning, organizing, and following through.
* The ability to build trusted relationships with people across functions, regions, and cultures.
* Clear communication and the confidence to guide conversations and facilitate sessions.
* Strong project coordination skills with attention to timelines, details, and dependencies.
* A detail\-oriented mindset and a structured way of working.
* Curiosity, openness to change, and a genuine interest in improving how things work.
* Comfort working with colleagues across cultures, countries, and stakeholder groups.
* Comfortable using Microsoft 365 and tracking tools to manage progress and follow\-up.
* Familiarity with HR systems and/or learning platforms would be helpful, but is not essential.

**Behavior**

* You are proactive, service\-minded, and enjoy bringing structure that helps others succeed.
* You build trust through empathy, reliability, and collaboration with employees, managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You demonstrate accountability, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
* You are comfortable working in a changing environment and bring a calm, constructive approach to evolving priorities.
* You live our values by working with collaboration, curiosity, responsibility, and customer focus.

**Experience:**

* 3–5 years of experience in HR, onboarding, talent management, learning coordination, project coordination, employee experience, or a related business support role.
* Experience coordinating onboarding or employee integration across multiple stakeholders and locations.
* Experience working in a global, regional, or cross\-functional environment is preferred.
* Experience supporting sales, business development, solutions, transformation, or growth initiatives is an advantage.

**Qualification:**

* A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Education, or a related field is preferred.
* We also welcome equivalent practical experience in onboarding, HR operations, learning coordination, or business project coordination.

**Contact information**  

For further information about this position, please contact:

  

Anouck White, recruiting manager, email: anouck.white@secotools.com


Suparna Ray, HR Business Partner, email: suparna.ray@secotools.com

  

Selection and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application through the job link as soon as possible, and no later than 31 August 2026\. To help us keep the recruitment process fair, smooth, and consistent for everyone, please submit your application only through the job link and not by personal email.

title: Associate Regional Capability Building Manager
description:
Associate Regional Capability Building Manager


**Category:** Human Resource Management
**Location:**Kolkata, West Bengal, IN  

**Associate Regional Capability Building Manager**  


**Department: Commercial Capability Building \- People \& Organization**  


**Organization \- Novo Nordisk India Pvt Ltd (Affiliate)**  


**Location \- Kolkata**
Are you ready to join a high\-performing team where your work directly shapes commercial success? We're looking for a motivated professional with sharp thinking, a customer\-first mindset, and a passion for developing others. If you enjoy working with people and want to build capability that moves the business forward, this is your opportunity.  


**Your new role**

As an Associate Regional Capability Building Manager, you will be the learning ambassador for your region — turning business and clinical insights into practical, evidence\-based training that improves team performance and patient outcomes. You will collaborate with Sales, Medical, Marketing, HR and field leaders to design, deliver and localise learning solutions, communicating the value of training while upholding the highest standards of ethics and compliance.  


**Your key responsibilities will include**
* Coach and develop Rare Disease and Public Care field teams through regular field visits and on\-the\-job coaching.
* Build capabilities in scientific communication, stakeholder engagement, account management, negotiation, and value\-based customer conversations.
* Strengthen team effectiveness in public healthcare systems, government reimbursement processes, institutional business, and market access.
* Partner with Sales, Medical, Marketing, Market Access, and regional leaders to identify capability gaps and implement targeted development initiatives.
* Design and facilitate learning programmes, workshops, simulations, and capability\-building interventions.
* Monitor capability development outcomes and drive continuous improvement through data\-driven insights.
* Support onboarding and development of new team members while fostering a coaching culture across the region.

  


**Your new department**  



The Sales Training team at Novo Nordisk India sits within Commercial Capability Building \- People \& Organization. Here, we build commercial capability by creating and delivering focused learning solutions — classroom, virtual and on\-the\-job — that strengthen product knowledge, sales skills and leadership behaviours. Working closely with cross\-functional departments, we translate strategy into learning roadmaps, measure impact and drive continuous improvement to enable better business performance.  


**Your skills \& qualifications**  



To be successful in this role, you should bring a blend of field experience and a genuine passion for developing others. We're looking for:  


* Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy or science from a recognised institution
* Minimum 2 years' experience in a Sales Training function
* At least 3 years' field sales experience in the pharma/healthcare sector (5\+ years total field sales experience preferred)
* Strong experience in Rare Disease, Public Care, Market Access, KAM, or Specialty Care businesses
* Expertise in government reimbursement and institutional healthcare systems
* Excellent communication, coaching, and facilitation skills
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management capabilities
* Proven ability to drive capability development and field excellence
* Creative, results\-driven mindset with solid operational execution; professional training certifications (e.g., ISTD Diploma) are a plus
* Willingness to relocate and travel regionally as required


**Working at Novo Nordisk**  



Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long\-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.  


**What we offer**  



There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.
**Contact**

To submit your application, Please upload your CV online (click on Apply and follow the instructions).  


**Deadline**  



2nd September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.  



At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

title: Product Manager - HR Technology
description:
**We're looking for a**
**Product Manager \- HR Technology**
====================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Product Manager – Workforce AI (HR Technology) \| Hyderabad**


Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)


**Team: AI Product Management**  

**Reports to: Senior Director, Strategic Programs (AI Product Management)**


**About the Role**


Cornerstone's Workforce AI platform is redefining how the world's largest organizations understand their people — building a skills\-first intelligence layer that connects workforce data, market signal, and a growing set of AI\-powered and agentic experiences.
  

We're hiring a Product Manager in Hyderabad to drive execution across the Workforce Intelligence platform, working hand\-in\-hand with our engineering teams. This role sits close to the build: you'll own delivery of platform capabilities from spec through release, ensure quality across the release pipeline, and serve as the connective tissue between global product strategy and day\-to\-day engineering execution.
  

This is a role for a PM who loves shipping — someone who is technical enough to earn engineering's trust, rigorous enough to own release quality, and customer\-minded enough to keep every sprint tied to real enterprise outcomes.


**In This Role You Will..**


Own delivery of platform capabilities end\-to\-end: requirements, specs, sprint planning, release readiness, and post\-release quality
  

Partner daily with engineering teams to translate product strategy into well\-scoped, buildable increments
  

Drive the release process for your workstreams — release notes, gating criteria, risk identification, and cross\-team dependency management
  

Own API and headless access capabilities, including agent tooling and developer\-facing experiences that let customers and partners build on the platform
  

Write clear, structured product artifacts: PRDs, technical specs, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios
  

Support enterprise customer deliveries by triaging escalations, validating fixes, and closing the loop between customer\-reported gaps and the roadmap
  

Contribute to platform quality and compliance practices, including documentation supporting SOC 2 and responsible AI requirements
  

Use AI\-assisted workflows as a core part of how you work — we build with AI, not just for it


**You Have Got What It Takes If You Have**


5\+ years of product management experience, ideally with enterprise SaaS or platform products — able to resolve a wide range of issues of diverse scope with good judgment in selecting methods and approaches


Strong technical fluency — you can read an API contract, discuss data models with engineers, and translate system architecture tradeoffs to drive intended business outcomes
  

Proven track record of shipping: you've owned releases, managed dependencies, and driven quality across a delivery pipeline
  

Experience with enterprise platform products; familiarity with AI\-powered or LLM\-based features is a strong plus
  

Crisp written communication — specs and status updates that engineers, executives, and customers can all act on
  

Comfort operating across time zones with globally distributed product and engineering leadership
  

Ownership mindset: you find gaps before they become escalations and close them without being asked
  

Nice to Have
  

Experience with HR tech, talent intelligence, skills platforms, or people analytics
  

Familiarity with developer platforms: APIs, SDKs, webhooks, or agent/tool protocols
  

Exposure to compliance\-driven product work (SOC 2, data privacy, EU AI Act)
  

Hands\-on experience prototyping with AI coding tools


**Why This Role**


You'll join a small, senior team building the AI backbone of a market\-leading platform, with exposure to global product leadership and enterprise customers — and you'll help define how AI\-native product teams operate.
  

Cornerstone is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team

  

\#LI\-Onsite


**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.


**Who We Are:**


Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.


Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!

title: General Manager
description:
**GENERAL MANAGER PC NASHIK \- EPIROC INDIA**  


*Are you a* *dynamic and result\-oriented leader with strong business and growth acumen? Do you enjoy nurturing those in your care while creating a sustainable and efficient production process?*  


*Join us as the General Manager for our Nashik Product Company and play a pivotal role in shaping the next phase of manufacturing excellence and sustainable growth for Epiroc India.*  


**About the Role**  



As General Manager, your mission is to lead and develop our Product Company in Nashik in a sustainable way, with a strong focus on volume growth, quality development, employee engagement and production efficiency. You will leverage the operations of several divisional factories within the existing Site I, while also taking ownership of the continued establishment and ramp\-up of Site II in Nashik.  



In this role, you will develop the production center into a world\-class example of operational excellence in manufacturing, always in line with Epiroc’s safety, health, environmental and quality standards. You will support key strategic initiatives and continue the Nashik growth journey to serve local, regional and global markets. In addition, you will drive the implementation of the Epiroc Flow methodology, including lean manufacturing tools, while creating a supportive, growth\-oriented and high\-performing organization.  



This position reports to the President of Epiroc India, with a matrix reporting line to the Vice President Operations of multiple equipment divisions.  


**Key responsibilities**  


* Lead and oversee manufacturing operations at Nashik Site I, while building and ramping up Nashik Site II and its supporting functions.
* Run the operations and deliver on KPIs across Safety, Health, Environment, Quality, Delivery and Cost.
* Grow volume output through the continued establishment of the second assembly plant in Nashik.
* Create sustainable results and continuously improve processes, while leveraging the Epiroc Flow program and LEAN ways of working.
* Drive the strategic development of the Product Company, based on the division’s production mission and strategy, as well as relevant Epiroc India strategic priorities.
* Strengthen quality development, increase production volumes and drive operational excellence across the organization.
* Cooperate with key stakeholders including global R\&D, global sourcing, global SHEQ and marketing/sales on product portfolio optimization to drive efficiencies and deliver strong customer value.
* Develop One Team to further strengthen collaboration between divisions and Nashik teams.
* Foster a high\-performing organization where people flourish in our culture, leadership is developed through Epiroc core values, and there is a strong talent pipeline.
* Ensure transparency and predictability in the company’s financials, while increasing profitability through continuous focus on functional cost efficiencies and operational excellence.
* Work closely with the India Centre of Excellence functions, including Finance, HR and Regional Supply Chain to boost volume growth, internal efficiency and external customer satisfaction.

  


**Experience and requirements**  


* Proven leadership experience in a production environment, with a focus on manufacturing processes, growth, quality development, LEAN methodologies and strong financial results.
* Previous experience of establishing new assembly plants is considered a strong advantage.
* Ability to lead strategic transformations and adapt to changing environments.
* Proven experience managing and nurturing diverse teams.
* University degree in a relevant field.
* Fluent spoken and written English is required.

  


**Location**  



Nashik, Maharashtra, India  


**Recruitment Process**  



Please send your application through our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than **2026\.09\.02**. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Please note that, due to the current regulations, **we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media**.  


*Epiroc provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, national origin, ethnic background, age, disability, political opinion, social status, veteran status, union membership or genetics.*  


*Epiroc complies with applicable country, state, and all local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location across the world in which the company has facilities. In addition, Epiroc supports the UN Guiding Principles for Business and Human Rights and the United Nations Global Compact.*  



**It all starts with people.** The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www.epiroc.com

title: Senior Workday Associate, Recruiting & Talent
description:
**This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of eight days per month in the office. During the probation period, you will be expected to work in the office at least four days per week. The role is based in our New Dehli office. Applicants must have existing work authorization in India at the time of application.**

**About Us:**

World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyse change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000\+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.


**About the Role:**

We are seeking an experienced and people\-focused **Senior Workday Specialist, Recruiting \& Talent** to take functional ownership of our Workday Recruiting and Talent modules across our country offices in Africa, Brazil, China, Colombia, Europe, India, Indonesia, Mexico, US. Sitting inside the global HR team and reporting to the Global Director, Compensation, Benefits, and Analytics, you will be the single point of expertise for these modules. You will partnering with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and regional HRBPs to translate business needs into smart, scalable Workday solutions.


Following our Workday journey to date, this role plays a critical enabling function, driving optimization, adoption, and continuous improvement of Recruiting and Talent processes across all country offices. You will work closely with the Workday Lead, Global IT, and HR teams across country offices to ensure the system is effectively supporting our people processes and hiring priorities.


**Job Highlight**

This is a hands\-on functional ownership role. You will design, troubleshoot, and continuously improve, and you will be the go\-to expert when a country office has a Workday related question on hiring or talent.


This role supports users across multiple global time zones; therefore, a degree of flexibility in working hours is expected to ensure effective collaboration and timely support. The role will require significant overlap with European working hours to enable coordination with key stakeholders.


**What you will do**

**Workday Functional Owner, Recruiting \& Talent (60%)**

* Manage the **Workday Recruiting module** end\-to\-end, including job requisitions, evergreen requisitions, job postings, career sites, candidate, prospect and referral configurations, offer/employment agreements workflows, questionnaires, and interview workflows.
* Manage the **Workday Talent Optimization module** , including goals, performance management and reporting – expanding to succession planning and talent reviews over time as we implement our systems roadmap.
* Maintain business processes, condition rules, calculated fields and dashboards across both modules, in alignment with global standards and local requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement: identify opportunities for system optimization, automation, and process simplification, and leverage Workday's latest features to keep our recruiting and talent practices ahead.
* Lead the bi\-annual Workday release cycle for your modules: assess new features, plan adoption, execute regression testing, and communicate changes to HR users.
* Maintain training documentation, business process workbooks, and the security model for your modules.

**Partnership \& Process Design (25%)**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and regional HRBPs to gather requirements, and configure solutions that work for local nuances without fragmenting the global model.
* Support integrations between Workday and the recruiting ecosystem: job boards, LinkedIn Recruiter, referral tools, background\-check platforms, assessment tools owning the functional side and partnering with IT on the technical build.
* Translate business requirements into smart, scalable solutions and communicate clearly with internal partners at all levels.

**User Support \& Capacity Building (15%)**

* Provide expert support across global offices: troubleshoot and resolve complex configuration and functional issues in collaboration with Global IT, Workday support, and external vendors.
* Produce and maintain training materials, job aids, and runbooks to empower self\-service for recruiters, hiring managers, and the wider HR team.
* Run sessions for country HR teams as new features or processes are rolled out.

**What you will need**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant work experience in lieu of degree is accepted.
* Workday Pro certification in Recruiting and/or Talent is preferred

**Experience**

* Minimum of 6 years of hands\-on experience with Workday HCM configuration and business process framework, with at least 3 years where Recruiting and Talent were your primary modules.
* Subject\-matter expertise in configuring job posting templates, career sites, job application business processes, candidate, prospect and referral workflows, offer letters, employment agreements.
* Strong working knowledge of Workday calculated fields as applied to Recruiting and Talent.
* Experience supporting HR teams across multiple countries and time zones, comfortable balancing global standards with local requirements.
* Experience contributing to Workday transformation, optimization or release projects.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a sharp eye for detail and a structured, hands\-on approach.
* Strong partner engagement skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Clear communication skills, a customer\-focused mindset, and a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality.
* Languages: verbal and written proficiency in English.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to adjacent Workday modules (Core HCM, Learning, Advanced Compensation).
* EIB and basic integration troubleshooting experience.
* Familiarity with ATS\-adjacent tools (LinkedIn Recruiter)
* Prior experience in a global HR team supporting multi\-country populations.

**Potential Salary and Benefits: INR 1400000 to 1750000 INR CTC Per Annum**

*“Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.”*

**Location:** New Delhi


**Start date:** As soon as possible


**How to Apply:** Please submit a resume with a required cover letter. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of qualified applications.


We are unable to consider your application without a cover letter in addition to your resume.


You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered


Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose.


**People\-centric to the core:**

We keep our people at the centre of everything we do \- from a welcoming work environment to benefits and a culture that encourages staff to stay healthy, happy, engaged, and growing.


**Some of the non\-monetary benefits that our staff get:**

**Health benefits:** We cover health insurance for you and your loved ones for up to INR 8 lakhs


**Term Insurance:** Our term insurance policy covers life coverage of 50 lakhs per staff member


**Employee Assistance program:** Promoting mental well\-being and supporting staff in achieving a satisfying work\-life balance


**Health \& Nutrition:** Personalized diet recommendation from a certified dietitian based on the physical health condition and lifestyle


**Flexible work schedule:** Alternative work arrangements for all who are eligible by nature of their job


**Learning culture:** Workshops and trainings to empower staff, encourage new learning opportunities


**Rest and Recharge weeks:** We encourage staff to take time off to rest, rejuvenate, upskill, and pursue their interests


**Our leave policy:** Avail personal time off at 36 per year, along with public holidays, maternity, paternity, and adoption leaves.
