title: HR Executive - Operations
description:
OHHPRO TECHNOLOGIES PVT. LTD.Company Profile

Ohhpro Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a technology\-driven organization focused on Software Development, IoT Solutions, Digital Transformation, Community Management Platforms, Security Solutions, Smart Infrastructure, and Enterprise SaaS Products.

Our flagship solution, **Ohhpro Junction**, is designed to support residential communities, housing societies, RWAs, commercial establishments, and enterprises through technology\-enabled community and operational management.

We work closely with housing societies, developers, facility management companies, channel partners, and enterprise customers to provide integrated technology and security solutions that improve operational efficiency, safety, automation, and customer experience.

Position

**HR \& Business Operations Executive**

Department

HR \& Operations / Business Development

Job Objective

The position is responsible for managing key HR and administrative operations while also supporting business development, client relationships, and expansion initiatives for Ohhpro Technologies' technology, security, automation, and digital solutions.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling internal HR operations as well as interacting with external clients, societies, developers, vendors, and business partners.

Key Responsibilities1\. HR Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day HR administrative activities.
* Maintain employee records, documentation, attendance, leave, and joining formalities.
* Coordinate onboarding, employee documentation, confirmation, and exit formalities.
* Maintain HR databases, trackers, and reports.
* Support payroll\-related data collection and monthly HR inputs.
* Coordinate employee communication and HR documentation.

2\. Employee Relations

* Handle day\-to\-day employee queries and concerns.
* Coordinate with employees and management to resolve workplace issues.
* Support employee engagement and internal communication activities.
* Maintain professional relationships with employees across departments.
* Assist management in implementing HR policies and processes.

3\. Statutory \& Compliance

* Support statutory HR and labour compliance activities.
* Coordinate documentation related to EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, NATS/Apprenticeship, and other applicable requirements.
* Maintain compliance records and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with external agencies, consultants, and statutory authorities whenever required.
* Ensure HR documentation and compliance activities are completed within defined timelines.

4\. Vendor \& Operations Coordination

* Coordinate with security, manpower, facility, technology, and other operational vendors.
* Monitor vendor attendance, deployment, documentation, and service compliance.
* Coordinate vendor requirements, issue resolution, and operational follow\-ups.
* Verify service\-related reports and supporting documents.
* Escalate operational issues to management and ensure timely closure.
* Assist in maintaining SOP compliance across operational activities.

5\. Recruitment Operations

* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities.
* Source and screen candidates according to job requirements.
* Coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Coordinate offer letters, joining formalities, and onboarding.
* Support campus recruitment, job portals, LinkedIn recruitment, and other hiring channels.
* Maintain recruitment reports and hiring status updates.

6\. Business Development \& Lead Generation

* Generate and qualify business leads across residential communities, RWAs, apartment associations, builders, architects, facility managers, and commercial establishments.
* Identify opportunities for **CCTV, security solutions, parking automation, access control systems, and digital advertising solutions**.
* Research potential clients and identify suitable business opportunities.
* Conduct initial discussions with prospective customers and understand their requirements.
* Coordinate product demonstrations, presentations, and client meetings.
* Maintain lead databases, follow\-ups, and business development reports.
* Support the sales team in converting qualified leads into business opportunities.

7\. Strategic Relationship Management

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with housing societies, developers, channel partners, facility management companies, and enterprise customers.
* Develop long\-term relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Coordinate with decision\-makers, society management committees, facility managers, and business partners.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate internally for suitable solutions.
* Support client retention and relationship\-building activities.

8\. Business Expansion \& Leadership Support

* Collaborate with the leadership team on business expansion initiatives.
* Assist in identifying new markets, customer segments, and partnership opportunities.
* Conduct basic market research and competitor analysis.
* Support strategic initiatives related to new products, services, locations, and business partnerships.
* Prepare business updates, lead reports, and opportunity summaries for management review.

Desired Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple HR and operational activities simultaneously.
* Basic understanding of HR processes and statutory compliance.
* Strong relationship\-building and client\-handling skills.
* Business development and lead\-generation mindset.
* Good negotiation and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace and basic reporting tools.
* Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and business development activities, whenever required.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Graduate / MBA / PG in HR, Business Administration, Operations, Sales, or a related field.
* Experience in HR Operations, Business Development, Operations, Administration, or a combination of these areas will be preferred.
* Candidates with experience in SaaS, technology, security solutions, facility management, real estate, or community management will be an added advantage.

What the Role Offers

* Exposure to both **HR Operations and Business Development**.
* Opportunity to work directly with leadership and business teams.
* Exposure to SaaS, IoT, security, automation, and smart infrastructure solutions.
* Opportunity to develop professional relationships with corporate clients, developers, housing societies, and channel partners.
* Career growth across HR, Operations, Business Development, and Strategic Business Functions.

About Ohhpro

At Ohhpro Technologies, we aim to build technology\-driven solutions that simplify community management, improve security, enable automation, and create smarter operational environments.

Our approach combines technology, people, and operational expertise to deliver practical solutions for modern residential and commercial communities.

**OHHPRO TECHNOLOGIES PVT. LTD.**  
Technology \| IoT \| SaaS \| Security Solutions \| Smart Infrastructure \| Community Management

Pay: Up to ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Manager - HR Business Partner
description:
Xperi invents, develops and delivers technologies that create extraordinary experiences at home and on the go for millions of people around the world. Powering billions of consumer electronics, connected cars and digital content titles, we make entertainment more immersive, driving more intelligent and every interaction seamlessly personalized through our renowned consumer brands: DTS®, HD Radio™ and TiVo®.
Xperi (NYSE: XPER) is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in San Jose, CA with over 1,500 employees across North America, Europe and Asia. Come join a thriving team where you can play an integral role in shaping the future of entertainment technology.
**About the Role**


This is an opportunity for an HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced setting, is comfortable partnering with senior stakeholders, and takes genuine pride in building high\-performing, well\-run organizations. You will report to the Site HR Leader and act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on everything from workforce planning to complex employee relations matters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Partnership \& Employee Relations**

* Serve as the primary HR advisor to managers, providing guidance on employee relations, policy interpretation, performance management, and workforce planning.
* Coach managers through what matters most — providing hands\-on consultation on org health, employee engagement, performance management, ER investigations, and complex people \- bringing clarity and sound judgment to every situation.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex HR issues, collaborating with HR Services and Centers of Excellence (CoEs) to ensure timely resolution.
* Own and scale end\-to\-end employee lifecycle operations — onboarding, offboarding, and transitions. Maintain HRIS data integrity.
* Monitor HR metrics to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities, and translate them into clear recommendations for the business.

**Compliance \& Vendor Governance**

* Oversee compliant, efficient processes for labour law requirements, statutory documentation, and filings coordination, ensuring the site remains audit\-ready at all times.
* Review and evaluate the performance of the third\-party payroll vendor against process and compliance benchmarks.

**Engagement \& Culture**

* Build and manage the annual employee events calendar, aligning it with organizational priorities and employee needs.
* Develop and manage corporate partnerships with wellness providers and employee benefit programs.

**Key Qualifications \& Experience**

* Master’s degree in human resources, or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience as an HR Business Partner and/or HR Generalist, ideally within Technology, Product, E\-commerce, or Consulting organizations.
* Demonstrated experience working within a matrixed HR organization, collaborating effectively across HR CoEs, Talent Acquisition, and business leadership.
* Knowledge of statutory compliance requirements preferred.
* Experience in a regional or multi\-country HR environment preferred.

**Life @ Xperi:**At Xperi, we value People, Customers, Performance and Innovation. We are dedicated to creating a workplace where all employees have a voice and sense of belonging, feel safe and valued, and are acknowledged for how their unique differences contribute to organizational culture and business outcomes.
Our employees and their families are important to us, and our comprehensive pay, stock and benefits programs reflect that. Xperi supports personal well\-being, builds financial security and enables employees to share in our collective success.
Rewards include:
* Competitive compensation (salary, equity and bonuses) and comprehensive benefits designed to foster work\-life balance, care for your health, protect your finances and help you save and invest for the future.
* Generous paid time away from work, including flexible time off, holidays and sick time, health and wellness initiatives, and a charitable match program to help you give back to your community.
* Great perks, which vary by location and can be site\-specific: employee discounts, transportation reimbursements, subsidized cafes and fitness facilities.
* A flexible, hybrid work environment combining the best of in\-office collaboration and community\-building along with the benefits of working from home.

title: Manager - Supply Chain Operations, Asia & Middle East
description:
**A.P. Moller \- Maersk** is an integrated logistics company working to connect and simplify its customers’ supply chains. As in dustry pioneers for over a century, the company operates in more than 130 countries with over 100,000 employees worldwide \& are w orking together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.
  

Through innovation and transformation we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.
  

Join us as we harness cutting\-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.
  

  

We are looking to hire an individual who will be responsible for overseeing and managing a regional team of professionals, accountable for the operational procurement of parts and services for a group of assets requiring expert knowledge. This role involves performing advanced relationship management with internal and external stakeholders involved in the operational supply chain and procurement.
  

The individual will also be tasked with problem\-solving and case handling of complex, urgent, or critical situations to support the team. Additionally, the person will be responsible for implementing the team’s engagement plan, enhancing skills, and developing the talent pool.
  

The role will require identifying, developing, and executing operational procurement and supply chain initiatives and kaizens, as well as monitoring KPIs and reporting on performance.


**ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Has accountability for service level, operational stability, performance and business continuity from a supply chain standpoint for a region of entities.
* Oversees and manages a team of buyers and managers responsible for operational procurement in clusters and/or entities.
* Be the SCO’s focal point for the procurement regional lead and regional ACM lead to support \& drive the procurement agenda within the region (transformation, automation, etc.)
* Has responsibility for advanced relationship management and problem solving with senior functional representatives (AM, INV, FIN, etc.) in the region and/or business unit.
* Accountable for the SCO’s buyers engagement, performance, upskilling and career growth.
* Identifies, develops, facilitates \& executes supply chain optimization projects \& Kaizens.
* Set a clear plan to develop \& maintain the team’s engagement and ensure its application.
* Responsible for the creation and maintenance of a growth plan for all team members via MPACT discussions.
* Represents Supply Chain operations in regional meetings and reports on performance.

**SAFETY**  

  

Employee should be always on top of physical security of information, both hard copy documents and electronic files, as well as following the APMT rules for accessing to specific websites and not installing/downloading forbidden software.


* Physical safeguard of assets is a priority for APMT personnel.

**FUNCTIONAL EXCELLENCE**

* Compliance with Procurement policies and procedures
* Advanced stakeholder management
* Close and active communication with all the Departments is necessary to comply on a timely basis with all of the commitments required in the position.

In this role, the individual will be working closely with the following groups:


**Internal:**

* All SCO Team members
* Procurement teams in the region
* ACM \& overall APMT procurement members
* Regional AM/INV and in the terminals
* Stakeholders in the terminals (SMT, Requisitioning \& Approving functions)
* HR

**External:**

Vendors  

* 

  

**What are we looking for?**

* 3\+ years experience in a leadership position, preferably in a Procurement role
* High level of understanding of business strategy
* Curiosity to understand customer needs, global trade, local and international market landscape, and how these interact
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish \& English
* Strong Analytical skills \& Performance management
* Exceptional Stakeholder management skills
* Passion for learning and coaching and improving business results capabilities development

* Advanced collaboration skills

* Is comfortable to deal with ambiguity and communicate clearly with people at all levels
* Has the ability to recognize potential in the team and to mentor it into growth

title: Solva Onboarding Coordinator
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Seco SOLVA is transforming manufacturing by going beyond cutting tools to deliver holistic, end\-to\-end solutions that improve efficiency, profitability, and competitiveness across the full production process. Built on Seco’s strong legacy, strategic partnerships, and innovative thinking, SOLVA helps manufacturers unlock their full potential through fast, easy, and sustainable solutions.


We are excited to welcome a Solva Onboarding Coordinator who can help create a smooth, consistent, and meaningful onboarding experience for colleagues joining our Business Development and Solva teams. This is a global role and can be based in any country.


**Job Summary:**  

As Solva Onboarding Coordinator, you will help new hires and internal transfers feel welcomed, prepared, and connected from day one. In this role, you will work closely with HR, leaders, and business stakeholders across regions to make sure each colleague has the information, tools, training, relationships, and follow\-up they need to contribute with confidence. The role may require international travel from time to time.


**Key responsibilities of the role:**

**Onboarding program management**

* Support the end\-to\-end onboarding journey for colleagues joining Business Development and Solva functions.
* Maintain clear onboarding roadmaps, checklists, and milestone plans from pre\-boarding through 30, 60, 90, and 180 days.
* Share clear onboarding updates with leaders and HR, including progress, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.

**New hire and transfer integration**

* Be a welcoming and practical point of contact for new hires and internal transfers during their initial onboarding period.
* Help create positive first connections through welcome communications, role introductions, stakeholder meetings, and functional orientation activities.
* Support both external hires and employees moving into new roles across Solva and Business Development.

**Cross\-functional coordination**

* Collaborate with HR, hiring managers, IT, L\&D, and business stakeholders to help ensure onboarding readiness before the start date.
* Ensure access, equipment, training assignments, onboarding sessions, and role\-specific materials are in place.
* Notice and raise any gaps or delays that may affect employee readiness or business continuity.

**Learning and capability enablement**

* Align role\-based onboarding content with Solva ways of working, tools, governance, process expectations, and customer journey understanding.
* Work together with the Solva L\&D / Upskilling Coordinator to connect onboarding with ongoing capability\-building programs.
* Keep onboarding materials current, accessible, and aligned with the evolving Solva operating model.

**Stakeholder connection and engagement**

* Coordinate buddy, mentor, or peer\-support assignments where relevant.
* Create inclusive opportunities for new colleagues to connect with Solva leaders, project teams, and subject matter experts.
* Listen to feedback from employees and hiring managers and turn their insights into practical onboarding improvements.

**Reporting and continuous improvement**

* Track onboarding completion, readiness milestones, feedback, and improvement actions.
* Prepare concise onboarding updates for HR and business stakeholders.
* Continuously improve templates, process flows, communication, and the overall onboarding experience.

**Required Competencies:**

**Skills and strengths we hope you bring**

* Experience in onboarding coordination, employee experience, or a related area.
* A structured approach to planning, organizing, and following through.
* The ability to build trusted relationships with people across functions, regions, and cultures.
* Clear communication and the confidence to guide conversations and facilitate sessions.
* Strong project coordination skills with attention to timelines, details, and dependencies.
* A detail\-oriented mindset and a structured way of working.
* Curiosity, openness to change, and a genuine interest in improving how things work.
* Comfort working with colleagues across cultures, countries, and stakeholder groups.
* Comfortable using Microsoft 365 and tracking tools to manage progress and follow\-up.
* Familiarity with HR systems and/or learning platforms would be helpful, but is not essential.

**Behavior**

* You are proactive, service\-minded, and enjoy bringing structure that helps others succeed.
* You build trust through empathy, reliability, and collaboration with employees, managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You demonstrate accountability, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
* You are comfortable working in a changing environment and bring a calm, constructive approach to evolving priorities.
* You live our values by working with collaboration, curiosity, responsibility, and customer focus.

**Experience:**

* 3–5 years of experience in HR, onboarding, talent management, learning coordination, project coordination, employee experience, or a related business support role.
* Experience coordinating onboarding or employee integration across multiple stakeholders and locations.
* Experience working in a global, regional, or cross\-functional environment is preferred.
* Experience supporting sales, business development, solutions, transformation, or growth initiatives is an advantage.

**Qualification:**

* A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Education, or a related field is preferred.
* We also welcome equivalent practical experience in onboarding, HR operations, learning coordination, or business project coordination.

**Contact information**  

For further information about this position, please contact:  

  



Anouck White, recruiting manager, email: anouck.white@secotools.com


Suparna Ray, HR Business Partner, email: suparna.ray@secotools.com  



  

Selection and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application through the job link as soon as possible, and no later than 31 August 2026\. To help us keep the recruitment process fair, smooth, and consistent for everyone, please submit your application only through the job link and not by personal email.

title: Team Lead - ACC
description:
**Innovate in Bengaluru**


This position is based at our on\-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting\-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on\-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.

 **About Lowe’s**  

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

**About Lowe’s India**


Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India

**About the Team**


Associate Contact Center (ACC) is the first the point of contact for phone, emails, and chat for US Lowe’s Associates. ACC provides services for \~300000 that includes Lowe’s Associates, Former Associates, Third Party Associates, non – Associates.

**Job Summary:**


The Lead, HR Service Center is Responsible for supervision, execution of resources allocated with the HR service center within the HR shared services organization. Assures call center operations and deliverables meet or exceed organizational objectives and service level agreements, follow service center strategies, and integrate as appropriate with other service center functions. Supports the broader HR service delivery model with a focus on customer service and assures alignment with HR "Centers of Expertise" (COEs) and other stakeholders such as field HR and HR Business Partners. Maintain the utmost confidentiality in dealing with employee records and business information. Direct and support the work of the service center staff (typically, a team of up to 10 positions). As a Lead, this role has significant responsibility regarding personnel and organizational matters (e.g., performance evaluations, increases, bonuses, discipline, and/or promotions) but approval and ultimate accountability may rest with the HR Service Center Manager/Director and/or head of HR Shared Services.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Core Responsibilities:**


Supervise responsibilities, provide leadership, evaluate performance, and drive service expertise for all entry level (Tier 1 / Category 1\) inquires to the service center (phone calls, emails, basic case management).


Conducts call monitoring and data integrity reviews to ensure that production and quality expectations are being met, providing timely feedback and coaching to ensure performance metrics are being met or exceeded; observes employee demeanor, technical accuracy, and conformity to company policies; conducts ongoing observations of program and services


Assure third party vendors perform according to service level agreements in support of HR service processes. Work with the internal HRIS team or appropriate COE and vendors to identify and correct problems and implement fixes.

* Lead documentation of HR service processes for the call center. Organize and facilitate ongoing review, development, evaluation/testing, and maintenance of documentation (e.g., Standard Operating Procedures, Work Instructions) to ensure complete, accurate, and up\-to\-date depiction of processes.
* Lead alignment meetings with COEs or HRBPs, as necessary, to capture new topics/inquiries that the Service Center may need to handle and assure that appropriate responses, routing, education, and/or knowledge base information is provided to Service Center staff. Perform audits and validations of Service Center transactions. Examine and verify Service Center related data for accuracy and consistency. Authorize or approve transactions as necessary
* Handle escalated and/or sensitive requests and issues from a Supervisor or Analyst. Escalate particularly specialized, difficult, or sensitive matters to the appropriate “Center of Excellence” resource and assure that cases are updated, maintained, and resolved accordingly.
* Provide excellent service to ensure activities provide the intended experience for end users in an efficient and effective manner. Manage tasks of self and team to assure Service Center deadlines are met according to established service levels/targets.
* Schedule resources to assure uninterrupted service to directors and employees. Coordinate with other managers as necessary regarding coverage for operational hours.
* Assure Compliance and Adherence to Business Objectives
* Participate in the development and delivery of training for internal staff, specialist groups, or others as needed.
* Maintain all compliance requirements. Analyze and correct errors and ensure proper quality controls are in place to avoid future errors.
* Assist the director with the execution of the compliance programs, internal audits, external audits, and government audits.
* Lead call center team performance and measure results to improve effectiveness and efficiency. Encourage continuous learning and work with the director to identify gaps and solutions. Assure support of strategic business \& operational direction and seek to drive continuous customer service improvements.
* Review, analyze, and reconcile relevant data according to established timelines, standards, and procedures.

**Years of Experience:**

* Minimum of 6 or more years’ functional experience required (e.g., HR call center/service center, HR functional area); preferably for a large multi\-state company as an HR shared services supervisor or COE specialist. (Preferred region – North America)

**Education Qualification \& Certifications (optional)**

**Required Minimum Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree, candidates with Human Resources, Business, Management, Organization Development, or related field will be preferred.

**Primary Skill Set Required**

* Experience leading and mentoring a team and helping to foster/create a “great place to work.”
* Experience delivering and improving HR processes to maximize efficiency \& deliver quality services.
* Experience with an ERP system preferred (Workday preferred). Experience with Microsoft tools and applications required.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build effective relationships with Tier2/Tier3 \& Functional COE’s.
* Customer service centric mind set, placing the user at the heart of the solution.

**Executive Assistant – Part\-Time**

About Brent Innovate

Brent Innovate is a London\-based software development and technology services company focused on delivering innovative, high\-quality software products and technology solutions that are intuitive, practical and designed around customer needs.

We provide business and management consulting, IT consultancy and advisory services across a range of industries, helping organisations improve performance through innovative technologies including **Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Analytics, Predictive Analytics, Machine Learning and Automation**.

Our work brings together software product design and management, technology and management consulting, business expertise, data and AI technologies, and digital innovation. Our team includes product and project managers, business and management consultants, data scientists, engineers and technology professionals who work collaboratively to help clients improve processes, systems and business performance.

At Brent Innovate, we believe our people are central to our success. We are looking for an **Executive Assistant** who is organised, proactive and highly dependable, and who will provide effective support to our senior leadership while helping the wider business operate smoothly.

About the Role

We are looking for a **detail\-oriented and organised Executive Assistant (EA)** to provide administrative and operational support to the **Founder and Director**.

This is a varied role that will involve executive administration, coordination, HR and people\-related administration, employee records, finance\-related administration and general business support.

You will regularly coordinate with the **Finance and People functions** and will be trusted to handle confidential company and employee information with a high level of professionalism and discretion.

The successful candidate will be a proactive problem solver who can manage multiple priorities, communicate confidently with different stakeholders and take ownership of tasks with minimal supervision.

Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive \& Administrative Support

* Provide day\-to\-day administrative support to the Founder and Director.
* Manage and coordinate meetings, appointments, calendars and follow\-up actions.
* Prepare documents, presentations, reports, correspondence and other business materials.
* Support the organisation and prioritisation of executive activities and deadlines.
* Maintain effective filing and document management systems.
* Coordinate internal and external communications on behalf of senior leadership when required.
* Assist with business projects, research and administrative tasks as directed.

HR \& People Administration

* Provide administrative support for HR and People\-related activities.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records.
* Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
* Maintain leave records and employee leave balances.
* Collect and maintain timesheet information to support the payroll process.
* Assist with HR documentation and employee communications.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of internal policies and processes.
* Ensure employee information is handled securely and confidentially.

Business Coordination

* Coordinate with Finance, People and other internal teams to ensure tasks and deadlines are completed efficiently.
* Help maintain and improve internal administrative processes and workflows.
* Coordinate information and resources across different functions.
* Track actions, deadlines and follow\-ups to ensure priorities are progressed.
* Assist with internal meetings, team communications and company activities.
* Help organise team events, meetings and occasional off\-site activities.

Confidentiality \& Professionalism

* Maintain strict confidentiality when dealing with company, financial, HR and employee information.
* Handle sensitive documents and information with discretion and professionalism.
* Maintain a high standard of accuracy and attention to detail across all responsibilities.

Objectives of the Role

* Support the Founder and Director effectively and proactively.
* Help ensure company priorities, deadlines and administrative requirements are managed efficiently.
* Maintain accurate and well\-organised employee and company records.
* Support smooth coordination between Executive, Finance and People functions.
* Improve and maintain internal administrative processes and workflows.
* Provide reliable administrative support as the business continues to grow.
* Contribute to a professional, organised and collaborative working environment.

Essential Skills \& Qualifications

* Previous experience in an **Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Administrator or similar role**.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organisational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities effectively.
* Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
* Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office**, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Comfortable learning and using new software, HR systems and business applications.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Ability to work collaboratively as part of a small, dynamic team.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to changing priorities.
* Professional and confident communication style.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.

Desirable

* Experience supporting a Founder, Director, senior manager or leadership team.
* Experience working in a technology, software, consultancy or professional services environment.
* Experience with HR software, employee management systems or payroll\-related administration.
* Experience maintaining employee records, leave records and timesheets.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based productivity and collaboration tools.
* Previous experience in a growing or entrepreneurial business.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Proactive** – you identify what needs to be done rather than always waiting for instructions.
* **Highly organised** – you can manage several priorities without losing track of details.
* **Reliable** – you take ownership of your responsibilities and follow tasks through to completion.
* **Discreet** – you understand the importance of confidentiality when working with senior leadership and employee information.
* **Adaptable** – you are comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can change.
* **Tech\-savvy** – you are comfortable with digital tools and willing to learn new systems.
* **Professional** – you communicate confidently and represent the company appropriately.
* **Collaborative** – you enjoy working with colleagues across different areas of the business.
* **Curious and willing to learn** – you are interested in technology, innovation and continuous improvement.

Why Join Brent Innovate?

Brent Innovate is a growing technology and consulting business where you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and gain exposure to a wide range of business functions.

You will work in an environment that encourages **innovation, creativity, continuous learning and professional development**, while gaining practical experience across executive support, business administration, HR and people operations.

We aim to develop world\-class professionals who are curious, innovative and motivated to build products and services that make a genuine difference to customers.

**If you are an organised, proactive and motivated professional looking for a varied part\-time Executive Assistant role within an innovative technology company, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Associate Legal Counsel (Assistant Manager)
description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 21 August 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title****Associate Legal Counsel (Assistant Manager)**

**Department** **Legal**

**Location****Gurgaon**

**Reports To****Senior Legal Counsel**

**Level** **4**


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

**About your team**


You will be part of the India Legal Team, within the Commercial Legal vertical, front\-ending drafting, review and negotiation of procurement and commercial contracts supporting Fidelity International's internal business units (Technology, HR, CPS, Marketing, Finance, etc.) and sourcing functions across global offices.


As part of Fidelity’s General Counsel function (Group Legal and Tax ), you will work closely with our legal, tax, regulatory compliance and commercial counterparts based in the Asia Pacific, United Kingdom, Continental Europe, Canada and other jurisdictions on cross border support covering commercial contracts, business legal document, Company Secretariat and other legal documentation.


The team’s focus is on providing agile, pragmatic, business\-aligned legal support while minimizing reliance on external counsel and ensuring minimum legal / regulatory exposure to the organisation.

**About your role**

  

This is a fast\-paced role within the Commercial Legal team, requiring high\-quality legal analysis, risk assessment, and cross\-border engagement. You will need a strong sense of commercial understanding, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work at pace with confidence.


Key aspects of your role include:

* Providing front\-end legal support for drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of procurement and commercial agreements, with particular emphasis on emerging technologies such as cloud services and GenAI.

* Interfacing directly with global stakeholders and advising on legal and compliance issues linked to onboarding third\-party tech solutions or developing in\-house capabilities, including those involving staff augmentation and temporary workforce arrangements
* Supporting cloud regulatory compliance work including review of new cloud/technology deployment requests, Cloud Regulatory Forum coordination, entity mapping and Local Compliance notifications.
* Collaborating with colleagues across functions and geographies to deliver pragmatic, business\-aligned legal solutions.


Contributing to continuous process improvement, knowledge sharing, and technology adoption within the team.


We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background, and strive to create an environment where everyone can thrive.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Draft, review and negotiate a variety of procurement and commercial contracts, including both technology and non\-technology engagements such as Cloud Outsourcing Agreements, SaaS, IaaS, Software Licences, Master Services Agreements, Statements of Work, Consulting and Facilities Agreements, Change Orders, and Data Processing Agreements.
* Independently manage strategic and complex technology vendor matters, including cloud, enterprise software, AI/GenAI, and data / market data providers, negotiating with major suppliers to secure favourable and risk\-appropriate terms.
* Support business and sourcing teams on onboarding third\-party AI and GenAI solutions or developing these in\-house, including IP, data, ethics, and regulatory considerations.
* Understand and interpret international Tech/Cloud Outsourcing regulations (ESMA, EBA, EIOPA, CSSF, DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR, DPDP Act, operational resilience requirements, etc.) and apply them to contracts.
* Review new cloud and technology deployment requests, coordinate with TRAO and Local Compliance on regulatory notifications and applicability assessments, and support Cloud Regulatory Forum processes.
* Collaborate with procurement to resolve legal and commercial issues and maintain compliance with company policies.
* Provide legal advice on matters related to existing procurement contracts and ongoing supplier service engagements, including amendments, renewals and terminations, balancing legal, regulatory, commercial and business considerations to mitigate risk and enable stakeholders to move forward with clarity and confidence.
* Research and stay current on emerging technology developments (AI, GenAI, blockchain, digital assets and tokenisation, cloud, crypto, open\-source software) and proactively assess their impact on commercial contracts and regulatory compliance.
* Prepare presentations, guidance notes and knowledge materials on emerging tech and related legal / regulatory themes for the team, sourcing and business stakeholders.
* Support legal operations and drive process improvements, including automating legal request intake, establishing knowledge\-sharing platforms, and developing AI/technology contracting playbooks and checklists for suppliers, the legal team and technology stakeholders; support training for sourcing and procurement teams on emerging tech and regulatory topics.
* Pursue relevant professional development including certifications, seminars and external sessions on data privacy, emerging tech regulation and related areas.
* Demonstrate adaptability, collaboration, and a proactive approach in all interactions.

**About you**


In this role you will be required to have:

* LLB with 5–6 years of relevant experience, preferably in an in\-house role within a multinational organisation (Financial Services, Asset Management, or Information Technology industries preferred).
* Experience in reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts across both technology and non\-technology engagements, including cloud services (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS), outsourcing, software licensing, market data, consulting, facilities, and profeesional services (staff augmentation, consulting etc.).
* Knowledge of cloud outsourcing regulatory frameworks (e.g., ESMA, EBA, DORA) and their application to technology contracts.
* Ability to assess commercial and legal risk relating to technology and outsourcing regulatory compliance.
* Familiarity with current technology trends such as AI, GenAI, platform integration, data processing, and their legal and regulatory implications.
* General understanding of how technologies work, including APIs, data security / backups, Cloud Escrow, and SaaS/IaaS/PaaS deployments and cloud security.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; excellent judgment; business sense.
* Excellent drafting and negotiation skills.
* Commercial judgement, business acumen, pragmatic and a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* High ethical standards and professional integrity.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple matters in parallel.
* Experience working on cross\-border contracts and international engagements.

* Genuine interest in technology and emerging tech – someone who keeps up with developments in AI, GenAI, cloud, blockchain and data privacy because they want to, not because they have to.
* Experience with contract management systems, e\-signature platforms, and other legal technology tools is desirable.
* Self\-starter, research\-oriented and self\-driven – able to take ownership of new and evolving matters with limited supervision, independently learn about new technologies, understand their contractual and regulatory implications, and translate that into practical guidance for stakeholders as the organisation’s technology priorities change.
* Comfortable presenting complex tech/regulatory topics to non\-legal audiences using presentations, diagrams and practical examples.
* Demonstrated adaptability, collaboration, and a proactive approach.
* Positive, pro\-active attitude suited to be a team member within a dynamic business environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

description:
**About the role**  


As a Systems Engineer Manager you are the first systems engineering management role. You impact positively the teams you lead, the people you manage and the products you are responsible for whilst helping build the right culture within your domain. You hire, develop, and retain our System Engineers to set them up for success. You build performing teams that consistently deliver quality outcomes, whilst empowering your engineers to own technical decisions. You work effectively with your stakeholders and product teams to ensure the right outcomes are delivered. You play a key role in formulating the technical strategy and roadmap for your area.
**You will be responsible for**  

Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:
I play an active role in people management and technical leadership. I impact the teams I lead, the people I manage and the products I am responsible for, whilst having a direct impact upon the environment and continuous improvement within my domain. I am responsible for building and developing high performing teams. I take accountability for the environment that my teams operate within and the processes and standards that facilitate high quality systems delivery. Ensuring the right product outcomes through the right technical strategy and trade\-offs. I build capability by hiring, retaining, and developing the careers of our engineers, ensuring opportunities for growth, and maintaining a level of challenge and motivation.


I establish and sustain the environment for development to succeed. My primary focus is to hire, develop and retain our Systems Engineers (SEs). I lead and develop our SEs through tailored plans, 1\-2\-1 meetings, coaching and mentoring whilst aligning opportunities to grow expertise alongside the goals of the wider team and business. I ensure SEs are set up for success and provide course corrections when needed.


I am responsible for building performing teams that consistently deliver quality systems whilst balancing the demands of timeframes and needs. I ensure the right levels of processes, practices, and standards to configure and operate products, aligned to the wider Technology strategy and standards. I involve in evaluation and recommend appropriate products to meet business needs. I drive continuous improvement across my teams and directorate, capturing the right data to affect our practices and delivery. I guide and empower my engineers to own technical decisions whilst understanding when guidance is needed.
I play a major role in the process of releasing value to our customers. I am accountable for the products I work on and proactively identify risks, propose mitigations, and understand when to escalate or ask for help. I build balanced, empathetic relationships with my stakeholders and product teams, collaborating effectively to ensure the right outcomes are delivered. I am a great communicator.

The HR Shared Services Compensation operations senior associate combines analytical rigour with a service\-orientated mindset. title: Director - Global Mobility - People Services
description:
**Job Description –**

This role has been updated to reflect the evolving Global Mobility operating model and the increasing importance of mobility as a strategic enabler of talent deployment, workforce planning and business transformation. The revised role strengthens accountability for business partnership, service transformation, operational excellence, compliance, technology modernization and value realization, while driving operational oversight global mobility governance and strategy as set out by the Global Mobility Centre of Excellence (CoE0\. The position leads a global mobility organization responsible for executing global mobility operations supporting international assignments, domestic relocations in US markets, cross border moves, immigration and business traveler activity across GSK, while driving simplification, digital transformation and continuous improvement of mobility services.


**Job Purpose –**

The Director, Global Mobility People Services is responsible for leading GSK's global mobility delivery/ operations functions and ensuring mobility programs effectively support business priorities, workforce planning and talent strategies while maintaining strong governance, compliance and employee experience. The role provides strategic leadership and expected to provide input to global mobility policy, manage governance, service delivery, immigration, vendor partnerships and operating model transformation. The position partners closely with Global Mobility CoE HR, Reward, Talent, Finance, Tax, Legal and business leadership teams. The role ensures the effective movement of talent globally while balancing employee experience, regulatory requirements, operational efficiency and cost effectiveness. The position leads to a globally distributed team and is accountable for the performance, implementing governance and continuous evolution of mobility services delivered through a combination of internal teams and strategic external partners In addition to the above, the role holder oversees the implementation of global mobility governance, vendor partnerships, technology transformation and continuous improvement initiatives, driving operational excellence, risk management and value creation working very closely with the Global Mobility policy \& Governance lead within Reward Coe.


**Key Responsibilities \-**

**Mobility Strategy \& Business Partnership**

* Execute GSK's global mobility strategy in alignment with business priorities, workforce planning and talent objectives.


* Partner with HR and business leaders to optimize talent deployment and mobility solutions across global markets.


* Provide strategic guidance on mobility implications associated with organizational changes, business expansion, critical talent deployment and workforce plans.


* Position mobility as a strategic enabler of growth, capability development and leadership mobility.


**Global Mobility Governance \& Policy**

* The Global Mobility policy is owned by Coe and the role holder will be responsible for delivery of international assignments, permanent relocations, domestic relocations, immigration and business traveler programs.


* Ensure mobility programs remain competitive, compliant and aligned to external market practices through ongoing benchmarking and review.


* Lead governance processes relating to policy exceptions, complex employee cases and high\-risk mobility decisions.


* Maintain effective controls and governance frameworks to ensure compliance with tax, immigration, payroll and regulatory requirements globally.


**Service Delivery \& Operational Excellence**

* Provide leadership and oversight for the end\-to\-end mobility lifecycle ensuring high\-quality service delivery, operational efficiency and employee experience.


* Drive service performance through effective management of operational metrics, controls and continuous improvement initiatives, that demonstrate business value and operational effectiveness


* Ensure operational execution is aligned to policy intent, governance requirements and business expectations.


* Act as the executive escalation point for significant mobility, compliance and stakeholder issues


**Vendor \& Commercial Leadership**

* Partner with Reward Coe to ensure vendor selection, engagement and relationship management has strong alignment internally


* Lead strategic relationships with key mobility, relocation, immigration, technology and tax partners.


* Establish governance frameworks to manage vendor performance, service quality, commercial outcomes and risk management.


* Drive optimization of vendor spend and delivery models to improve service outcomes and maximize value.


* Lead vendor selection, contract renewal and service transformation initiatives as required.


**Digital Transformation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Sponsor and lead the Global Mobility Technology Transformation Programme through completion and realization of benefits.


* Drive adoption of AI, automation and digital solutions to simplify processes, enhance employee experience and improve operational efficiency across the mobility service model


* Identify and implement opportunities to improve scalability, service quality and operational efficiency.


* Use data, analytics and insights to support decision making and demonstrate business value delivered through mobility services


**Leadership \& Team Development**

* Lead and develop a globally distributed mobility team spanning operations, regional mobility management, immigration and mobility advisory services.


* Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, continuous improvement and customer focus.


* Build succession, capability and leadership depth across the Global Mobility organization.


* Champion employee engagement, development and high performance across the team.


**Breadth/Scope of Accountability –**

**Team Leadership**

* Leads a global mobility organization of approximately 22 employees across mobility operations, regional mobility management, immigration and advisory services.


* Direct leadership of senior managers and functional leaders across APAC, EMEA, Americas, Operations and Immigration.


**Business Impact**

* Accountable for global mobility governance, operational performance and service delivery across GSK.


* Supports the movement of employees across multiple markets and business units globally.


* Ensures effective management of compliance, tax, immigration and regulatory risks associated with international mobility programs.


**Vendor Accountability**

* Owner of strategic mobility partnerships in partnership with Reward Coe including relocation management, immigration providers, tax advisors and global mobility technology platforms. Eg : EY, Equus, K2, immigration providers and other mobility partners


**Change \& Transformation**

* Sponsor for mobility transformation initiatives, technology modernization and operating model simplification.


**Experience Required \-**

* Significant experience leading global mobility programs globally distributed teams, within a large multinational organization.


* Strong understanding of international mobility, immigration, tax and compliance frameworks.


* Experience influencing and partnering with senior business leaders, HRLT members and enterprise stakeholders across multiple geographies


* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale transformation, process improvement or technology initiatives.


* Strong vendor governance and commercial management experience.

  

  

**Skills**

Business Acumen, Case Management Software, Global Mobility, Immigration Consulting, Influencing Without Authority, Internal Mobility, Operational Excellence, Operational Risks, Problem Solving, Regulatory Compliance Management, Stakeholder Management, Vendor Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.


People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.


**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.


Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.


**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day \- Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on\-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support.
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.


**About the role**
------------------

As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross\-team coordination that keeps India\-based engineering and US\-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor \- not a team of TPMs \- which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup.


You will work directly with the Product Managers (US\-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high\-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it.


Responsibilities


* Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes.
* Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins.
* Own the US\-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap\-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async\-first practices that keep live meeting load low.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery.
* Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles.
* Document the team's operational model: post\-launch on\-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business\-as\-usual operations.

title: Executive assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE FOUNDER

Job Description

Role

Executive Assistant to the Founder

Department

Founder’s Office / Administration

Reporting to

Managing Director

Location

Alipore Central Office

CTC

₹20,000 – ₹22,000 per month, depending on experience

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and dependable Executive Assistant to the Founder who can help manage the Founder’s priorities, ensure that tasks are followed through to completion, and keep the administrative and people\-related processes of the business organised.This role is ideal for someone who is extremely strong on follow\-ups, coordination, documentation and execution. The EA will act as the Founder’s right hand, ensuring that decisions and instructions are converted into clear tasks, assigned to the right people and followed through until closure.The role will also support HR and general administration, including recruitment coordination, employee documentation, attendance, leave records and formal employee communication.

1\. Founder’s Office \& Executive Support

* Manage the Founder’s calendar, priorities, meetings and reminders. **Maintain a clear and updated list of the Founder’s pending tasks and priorities.** Convert discussions, instructions and ideas into clear, actionable tasks with owners and deadlines. **Maintain a live tracker of all important tasks and follow up regularly until completion.** Ensure that important decisions made by the Founder are communicated to the relevant team members and executed. **Proactively remind the Founder about pending decisions, deadlines and important follow\-ups.**

2\. Team Follow\-Up \& Execution

* Follow up with managers and team members on pending tasks and deliverables. **Collect daily EOD reports and ensure they are submitted on time.** Maintain a central tracker of pending tasks, owners and deadlines. **Identify delays or lack of follow\-through and escalate important issues to the Founder.** Follow up firmly but professionally to ensure accountability. **Ensure that action points from meetings are actually completed rather than simply recorded.**

3\. Meetings \& Documentation

* Prepare meeting agendas when required. **Take clear meeting notes and record action points.** Circulate action points to relevant team members. **Track meeting deliverables and follow up until closure.** Maintain organised records of important documents, decisions and communications.

4\. Recruitment \& HR Coordination

* Coordinate recruitment with hiring agencies and other recruitment sources. **Maintain the candidate pipeline and schedule interviews.** Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and management. **Prepare and coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, probation and confirmation letters.** Maintain complete and organised employee files and documentation. **Maintain employee leave and attendance records.** Coordinate attendance and payroll\-related information with the Finance team. **Prepare formal warning letters, disciplinary letters and other employee notices when required.** Ensure confidentiality and IP agreements are completed and properly filed.

5\. General Administration

* Maintain organised company records and administrative documentation. **Coordinate with different departments on administrative requirements.** Ensure important paperwork, approvals and documentation are completed on time. **Support the Founder with ad\-hoc administrative and coordination requirements.** Keep track of recurring administrative deadlines and ensure nothing is missed.

Systems \& Trackers Owned

* Founder’s priority and follow\-up tracker **Team task and EOD compliance tracker** HR records and employee documentation **Recruitment and candidate pipeline** Leave and attendance records **Meeting action\-point tracker**

Performance Will Be Measured On

* Percentage of Founder’s tasks driven to completion **Timeliness and accuracy of team EOD reporting** Follow\-through on pending tasks and action points **Timeliness and accuracy of HR documentation** Recruitment coordination and candidate pipeline management **Organisation and completeness of employee records** Ability to proactively identify pending matters before they become problems **Reduction in the Founder’s day\-to\-day tracking, reminding and administrative workload**

Candidate Profile

* 3\+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, HR Generalist, Office Manager or in a similar coordination role. **Experience working closely with a founder, director or senior management is preferred.** Exceptionally organised and detail\-oriented. **Strong follow\-through and task management skills.** Proactive rather than waiting to be instructed. **Comfortable coordinating with multiple departments and following up with senior team members.** Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Good command of English and Bengali.** Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets, documentation and basic office systems. **Mature, discreet and trustworthy with confidential business and employee information.** Able to be polite but firm when following up with people. **Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, founder\-led business where priorities can change quickly.**

Ideal Candidate

The ideal person is someone who does not need to be reminded to follow up.They should naturally keep track of what is pending, who is responsible, what the deadline is and whether it has actually been completed. They should be comfortable taking a messy discussion or a list of instructions from the Founder and turning it into a structured execution plan.The most important qualities for this role are ownership, organisation, discretion, urgency and excellent follow\-through.

Pay: Up to ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

We are looking for an experienced **HR Lead – HR Operations** to manage and strengthen the day\-to\-day HR operations of the organization. * Manage end\-to\-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to exit.
* Maintain employee records, HR documentation, and personnel files.
* Ensure timely completion of joining formalities, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Develop and improve HR policies, processes, SOPs, and workflows.
* Ensure accurate and timely HRMS updates and employee data management.

**2\. Payroll \& Attendance**

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the payroll/finance team.
* Validate attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, and other payroll inputs.
* Resolve employee queries related to payroll, attendance, leave, and benefits.
* Maintain accurate employee and payroll\-related records.

**3\. Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Keep the organization updated on changes in labour regulations and HR compliance requirements.

**4\. Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Drive smooth onboarding and induction processes.
* Manage probation reviews and confirmation processes.
* Handle employee transfers, promotions, salary revisions, and other employee movements.
* Conduct and manage exit formalities, full \& final settlement coordination, and exit documentation.

**5\. Employee Engagement \& HR Support**

* Drive employee engagement initiatives and internal HR activities.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee HR\-related queries.
* Support managers in handling employee concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters.
* Maintain a positive employee experience and workplace culture.

**6\. Performance Management**

* Coordinate the performance appraisal process.
* Ensure timely completion of goal setting, reviews, and appraisal documentation.
* Support managers in performance\-related discussions and documentation.

**7\. HR MIS \& Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain HR dashboards and MIS reports covering:
* Headcount
* Attrition
* Attendance
* Leave
* Recruitment
* Payroll
* Employee movements
* Statutory compliance
* Provide regular HR reports and insights to management.

**8\. HR Process Improvement**

* Identify gaps in existing HR processes and implement improvements.
* Introduce automation and technology to improve HR operational efficiency.
* Ensure HR processes are standardized and consistently followed across teams.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in **HR, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* Good knowledge of **Indian labour laws and statutory compliance**.
* Hands\-on experience in payroll, attendance, HRMS, employee lifecycle management, and HR documentation.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information professionally.
* Strong MS Excel/Google Sheets and HRMS skills.
* Experience in managing HR processes independently is preferred.

Key Success Measures

* 100% accuracy and timeliness of HR operations and payroll inputs.
* Timely completion of statutory compliances.
* Smooth onboarding, confirmation, transfer, and exit processes.
* Accurate and updated employee records.
* Improved employee experience and HR process efficiency.
* Timely and accurate HR MIS reporting.

title: Workday HRIS Specialist, Senior Principal ( Advanced Compensation and Integrations)
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) \- the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI\-powered applications and experience with agility and ease.


We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **HRIS Specialist, Senior Principal** and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Learn More about **us**


We are hiring an experienced Workday Technical and Functional Consultant to act as the single point of contact between our HR, Finance, IT and business stakeholders and the Workday delivery team. This is a hands\-on configuration role, not a program management role: the successful candidate will have spent the last 10 years working inside Workday tenants, configuring solutions, building and troubleshooting integrations, and producing reporting that leaders actually use.


The role sits at the center of demand and delivery. Requests arrive from many directions and in many forms, from a one\-line question about an eligibility rule to a multi\-quarter programme of work. This person translates those requests into clear problem statements, sizes them honestly, and then distributes the work across the full delivery group, which spans our internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant. Part of that judgement is deciding at the point of intake which items should sit with the consultant from the start rather than being picked up internally and handed over later. Equally important is the ability to explain the resulting design back to the requesting team in plain business language, and to the delivery group in configuration terms.

**In This role, you will :**

**Stakeholder Engagement and Requirement Intake**

* Serve as the single point of contact for all stakeholder groups raising Workday demand, running a consistent intake process rather than an ad hoc queue.
* Gather, challenge and document requirements from HR, Payroll, Finance, IT and business leaders, converting loosely worded asks into precise, testable problem statements.
* Translate business problem statements into functional and technical design for the team, and translate proposed Workday solutions back into language the requesting team can validate and sign off.
* Maintain a single prioritized demand backlog, agree sequencing with stakeholders, and communicate trade\-offs when capacity is constrained.
* Run design walkthroughs, impact assessments and readiness sessions ahead of each Workday release.

**Configuration and Solution Design**

* Own end\-to\-end configuration design across the Workday footprint, working hands\-on in the tenant rather than directing others from a distance.
* Configure and troubleshoot business processes, condition rules, security groups, domain and business process security policies, calculated fields and eligibility rules.
* Assess downstream impact of every change across modules before it is built, and protect tenant hygiene through disciplined use of sandbox, sandbox preview and production migration practices.
* Define and enforce configuration standards, naming conventions, testing expectations and documentation for the team.

**Integrations and Reporting**

* Design, build and support integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio and web services, including error handling, monitoring and re\-run procedures.
* Act as the technical authority on integration issues raised by vendors and downstream system owners, and drive root cause analysis to closure.
* Build advanced, matrix, composite reporting, and advise stakeholders on the right reporting approach rather than building every request as asked.
* Ensure reporting and integration outputs respect data privacy, segregation of duties and audit requirements.

**Work Sizing, Prioritization and Distribution**

* Assess the complexity, risk and effort of each incoming requirement and assign it to the right owner across the delivery group, which includes internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant.
* Balance workload across internal team members and consultant capacity, track progress against commitments, and escalate early when a commitment is at risk.
* Review the work of internal team members and the consultant, provide technical coaching, and raise the overall configuration capability of the group.

**Sourcing Decisions at Intake**

* Decide at the point of intake, rather than mid\-delivery, which items should go to the consultant from the start and which the internal HRIS team should own, based on complexity, specialist skill requirements, timeline pressure and internal capacity.
* Prepare scope and requirement documentation for consultant\-delivered work, review the designs and deliverables that come back, and hold the consultant to quality and timeline expectations.
* Track the split between internal and consultant delivery, and advise leadership on where that boundary should sit as internal capability grows.

**Subject Matter Expertise Required**


The candidate must demonstrate working familiarity with all Workday modules in our footprint and deep, demonstrable subject matter expertise in the following two areas:

* **Advanced Compensation**, including compensation and merit plan configuration, eligibility rules, compensation review cycles, bonus and stock processes, matrices and worksheet configuration, and troubleshooting cycle issues under time pressure.
* **Integrations**, including EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, web services, integration security configuration, and the operational support model that keeps integrations running.

**Your Background :**

* Overall 12\+ years of experience in HR Systems**.** ***Minimum 10 years of experience working exclusively on the Workday configuration side, in a technical and functional consulting or in\-house product capacity.***
* Working knowledge of all Workday modules, with the ability to reason about cross\-module impact rather than treating each module in isolation.
* Subject matter expertise in **Advanced Compensation and Integrations**, evidenced by full\-lifecycle delivery in both.
* Strong reporting capability across advanced, matrix, composite reporting, and comfort with calculated fields.
* Proven experience as the requirements owner or single point of contact for a stakeholder community, including prioritization and expectation management with senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to size and distribute work across a mixed\-seniority team, and to decide at intake which work belongs with internal team members and which with an external consultant.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical design to non\-technical audiences and business intent to technical colleagues.
* Willingness to work the **1:00 pm to 10:00 pm shift** and to be present in the **Bengaluru or Hyderabad office two days per week.**
