**Robot Programming Engineer**
**Responsibilities**
 Functions to develop:
   

  

* Develop offline robot programs using DELMIA Robotics / Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE.
* Create, simulate, and validate robotic manufacturing processes for assembly, welding, drilling, sealing, painting, material handling, and fastening operations.
* Generate and optimize robot paths to achieve required cycle times while maintaining product quality and safety.
* Configure robot work cells, end\-of\-arm tooling (EOAT), fixtures, positioners, conveyors, and peripheral equipment within the 3DEXPERIENCE environment.
* Perform robot reachability studies, singularity analysis, collision detection, and interference checks.
* Simulate robot motion, process sequences, and multi\-robot coordination to validate manufacturing feasibility.
* Develop and validate robotic process logic, task sequencing, and operational workflows.
* Support virtual commissioning activities by integrating robot programs with PLC logic and manufacturing systems.
* Optimize robot utilization, motion efficiency, payload handling, and workstation layout.
* Generate robot program outputs compatible with OEM robot controllers (ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, etc.).
* Troubleshoot robot simulation issues and optimize existing offline programs.
* Maintain digital manufacturing models and ensure synchronization between engineering data and robot programs.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Automation, Controls, Industrial Design, Production, and Quality teams.
* Prepare technical documentation, simulation reports, robot program documentation, and work instructions.
* Support commissioning, production ramp\-up, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Qualifications**
 Any Graduation / Diploma in Engineering / Aircraft Maintenance Engineering (AME), or an equivalent technical qualification is preferred.
   

  

**Essential Skills**
* Strong understanding of industrial robotics and automated manufacturing systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Robotics / 3DEXPERIENCE.
* Knowledge of robot kinematics, motion planning, and trajectory optimization.
* Experience in offline robot programming and robotic simulation.
* Understanding of robotic work cell design and manufacturing automation.
* Knowledge of robot calibration, Tool Center Point (TCP), user frames, and coordinate systems.
* Experience with robot path optimization, collision avoidance, and reachability analysis.
* Understanding robotic process planning for welding, fastening, drilling, painting, sealing, assembly, and material handling.
* Knowledge of robot controller architectures and program generation.
* Understanding of PLC interfaces and robot\-controller communication.
* Familiarity with manufacturing process planning and digital manufacturing workflows.


**Desired Skills**
**Software Skills :**
* Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE (DELMIA Robotics)
* Siemens Tecnomatix Process Simulate / ABB Robotstudio / Fanuc ROBOGUIDE / KUKA.Sim
* Delmia Process Engineering
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (MS Office)


**Desired Skills**
* Experience in aerospace, automotive, or advanced manufacturing industries.
* Experience with offline robot programming and optimization.
* Understanding of PLC programming languages (IEC 61131\-3: Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, Structured Text).
* Experience integrating robots with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, and MES.


**Experience**
* Lead / Senior Manufacturing Engineer: 6–10 years of relevant experience
* Experience in the aerospace or aerostructure industry/offline robot programs background is an added advantage.

* Collaborative working environment – We stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers, developing solutions that create a sustainable today and tomorrow.

title: Robotic welding programmer & operator
description:
**Company Description** 
 SEA Hydrosystems is a hydraulic cylinder manufacturer and supplier founded in 2010 and based in Chennai, India, with a modern production facility in Sriperumbudur. The company designs, manufactures, and exports high\-performance hydraulic cylinders and power units for industries such as construction, mining, agriculture, and material handling. SEA Hydrosystems specializes in custom\-engineered solutions that deliver durability, precision, and performance for demanding OEM and heavy\-duty applications worldwide. From standard tie\-rod and welded cylinders to telescopic and custom\-built systems, every product is designed for reliability and long\-term efficiency. The company aims to power machinery globally with world\-class hydraulic technology and robust engineering support.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Robo Welder role based in Poonamallee. The Robo Welder is responsible for operating and monitoring robotic welding equipment used in the production of hydraulic cylinders and related components. Daily tasks include preparing materials and fixtures, loading parts into welding cells, selecting and verifying welding programs, and performing basic parameter adjustments to ensure consistent weld quality. The role involves inspecting welds for defects, measuring parts against specifications, and coordinating with supervisors and quality teams to resolve issues. The Robo Welder also performs routine equipment checks, supports minor maintenance, follows safety and housekeeping standards, and collaborates with production colleagues to meet output and delivery targets.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong welding skills, with experience in Welding and Arc Welding for industrial or heavy\-duty applications.
* Hands\-on proficiency in TIG Welding and MIG Welding, with the ability to select appropriate processes based on job requirements.
* Knowledge of Materials used in hydraulic cylinders and structural components, including basic understanding of steel grades and weldability.
* Experience operating robotic or automated welding systems, including loading/unloading parts and adjusting basic parameters.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, weld symbols, and production work instructions.
* Attention to detail with practical skills in visual inspection and use of measurement tools (calipers, gauges, etc.).
* Commitment to safe working practices, including PPE use, adherence to safety procedures, and awareness of hazards in welding operations.
* Previous work experience in manufacturing, fabrication, or heavy engineering environment; exposure to hydraulic products is an advantage.
* Relevant technical education or certification in welding, fabrication, or mechanical trades preferred.
* Ability to work in shifts, stand for extended periods, and handle the physical demands of shop\-floor work.
* Effective teamwork and communication skills to coordinate with operators, supervisors, and quality inspectors.

 Clinical \& Surgical Support

 Experience in

**The Kind of Person We’re Looking For**

 We’re looking for a

 —someone who doesn’t need detailed instructions for every task.
 



 Someone who sees something missing and takes the initiative.

 Someone who asks:

 Build simple, reliable and intuitive digital self\-service journeys that allow customers to manage their bookings independently. Identify relevant opportunities to upsell products and services post booking, helping customers enhance and protect their upcoming trip.

 Own end\-to\-end post\-sales customer journeys across key servicing use cases such as cancellation, date change, refunds, disruptions, web check\-in, flight status and booking management. Defining, measuring, and improving customer frustration scores across bot interactions, and using these insights to refine flows and responses.  If you’re looking for a role where you can own meaningful problems, build quickly, and see the impact of your work end\-to\-end, this is the role for you.

 Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments run, validation rate before engineering involvement

 Sprint predictability, on\-time delivery %, rework, cycle time

 Reduction in manual effort, turnaround time improvement, process efficiency gains

 Feature adoption, conversion improvement, operational efficiency, experiment velocity

Job Title: Technical Project Manager

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a sharp, proactive, and highly articulate Technical Project Manager to keep our cross\-functional engineering initiatives moving fast and smoothly. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical engineering teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. You won't just be tracking tasks you will own project plans, anticipate risks before they happen, and ensure transparent, straightforward communication across departments. If you thrive on turning technical ambiguity into clear, actionable plans and can speak comfortably with both a software engineer and a business leader, this role is for you.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Stakeholder Management \& Candid Communication
* Cross\-Departmental Coordination: Serve as the central point of contact between Engineering, Product, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success.
* Candid \& Clear Articulation: Communicate project status, trade\-offs, and blockers with honesty, clarity, and zero fluff, ensuring both technical and non\-technical stakeholders understand the "why" behind decisions.
* Senior Leadership Updates: Craft concise, accurate executive summaries and deliver candid status reports to senior leadership, keeping them informed without swamping them in jargon.
* Technical Execution \& Delivery
* Project Ownership: Build, maintain, and track detailed project schedules, milestones, and resource allocation from kickoff through launch.
* Technical Understanding: Translate product requirements into actionable technical tasks alongside engineering leads, ensuring scope clarity and feasible estimates.
* Risk Management \& Problem Solving: Actively spot dependencies, bottlenecks, and scope creep early. Facilitate quick resolution meetings to keep timelines on track.
* Reporting \& Process Optimization
* Status Reporting: Maintain a reliable cadence of daily/weekly status reports, dashboards, and release notes to keep all teams aligned.
* Agile Facilitation: Help lead and support core Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Standups, Backlog Grooming, Retrospectives).
* Continuous Improvement: Look for ways to streamline workflows, remove organizational friction, and sharpen team handoffs.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Experience: 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience managing technical projects or software development lifecycles (SDLC) in an Agile environment.
* Communication Mastery: Exceptional verbal and written communication. You know how to tailor your message whether you're emailing an executive, running a daily standup, or presenting to sales.
* Technical Grounding: Basic\-to\-intermediate technical fluency (e.g., understanding APIs, cloud infrastructure, web technology, or software architecture enough to ask engineers the right questions).
* Tooling Expertise: Proficient with project management software like Jira, Confluence, Asana, Trello, or Monday.com.
* Analytical \& Detail\-Oriented: Great at organizing messy information into clean project timelines, tracking metrics, and documenting risks.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications are a plus, but not required (e.g., CAPM, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or PMI\-ACP).
* Experience with metrics reporting (e.g., sprint velocity, burndown charts, lead/cycle time).

title: Associate Program Manager
description:
Every day, millions of vehicle owners depend on dealership service departments to keep them on the road. We build the software that helps those service teams communicate with customers, schedule repairs, approve work, collect payments, and deliver a better experience from start to finish.
   

  

 myKaarma is a leading SaaS platform serving dealerships across North America. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, with a global team, we're growing by solving real operational problems with practical technology.
   

  

 We believe the best ideas come from people who take ownership, question how things can be improved, and care deeply about the customer experience. If you're excited to build products that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

**Role Description**
 As an Associate Program Manager at myKaarma, you will be the execution backbone of our OEM\-facing programs, strategic partnerships, and internal process improvement initiatives. While senior Program Managers own program strategy and client relationships, you will own the day\-to\-day machinery that keeps programs moving, coordinating across teams, tracking deliverables, preparing reports and analyses, and resolving first\-line technical issues. This is a growth role: you will gain direct exposure to OEM programs and the automotive SaaS ecosystem, with a clear path toward independently managing programs as a Program Manager.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* Finding a Way Through: Every program hits walls, a blocked integration, a stalled approval, a stakeholder who has gone quiet. You treat “stuck” as a puzzle, not a status: you find the workaround, the right person, or the reframe that gets things moving again.
* Systematic Project Planning: Run the project plan as a living system — milestones, dependencies, owners, and risks mapped and always current — so senior Program Managers and stakeholders know exactly where a program stands and what is coming next.
* Stakeholder Expectation Management: Understand what each stakeholder — OEM Account Executives, engineering, product marketing, clients — actually needs versus what they are asking for, and keep everyone’s expectations aligned with reality. Early bad news always beats late surprises.
* Everyday Negotiation: Negotiate constantly — timelines with engineering, scope with clients, priorities across teams — looking for the trade that leaves both sides better off, not the compromise that leaves both worse.
* High EQ, On Purpose: Read the room. Sense frustration before it becomes escalation, adapt your communication style to each audience, and stay composed when a program gets messy — because it will.
* Reporting \& Data Analysis: Build and maintain operational reports and data analyses for OEM clients and Account Executives, turning raw data into insights that help mK sell and retain business.
* Meeting Preparation \& Support: Prepare the data, materials, and pre\-reads for business review meetings with manufacturers; attend alongside senior Program Managers and present designated sections as you build experience.
* Learning \& Continuous Improvement: Learn and apply Lean/Toyota Production System (TPS) principles in daily work; maintain risk logs and status reports, flagging emerging issues early rather than hoping they resolve themselves.
* Fresh Perspective: Bring ideas from customer interactions, data, and new technology into program discussions — an associate’s outside view is expected, not optional.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering with a strong background in programming and MBA in Operations Management
* 2\+ years of experience in program/project management, ideally within the automotive industry or SaaS applications.
* Proven ability to build and run a systematic project plan — breaking work down, mapping dependencies, assigning owners, and keeping the plan honest as reality shifts.
* Demonstrated ability to manage the expectations of multiple stakeholders with competing priorities — clients, engineering, and leadership — without losing anyone’s trust.
* A resourceful problem\-navigator with a track record of getting things unstuck — finding the right person, the creative workaround, or the missing piece of information — and quick to learn new systems.
* High emotional intelligence: self\-awareness, empathy, and composure under pressure — you notice how people are feeling and factor it into how you work.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business audiences.
* Experience with project management tools such as SmartSheet, Jira, Asana, or Monday.com.
* Strong negotiation skills, comfortable trading scope, time, and priorities at every level, and able to hold a position without damaging a relationship.
* PMP, Agile, or Scrum certifications are a plus.


**How To Stand Out**
 At myKaarma we value individuals who think beyond traditional account management and partnership strategies. Here’s what sets exceptional candidates apart:
   

  

* Honeycomb Innovators: You approach challenges with the “honeycomb” mindset—filling knowledge gaps, uncovering overlooked opportunities, and driving breakthrough solutions.
* Customer\-Centricity: You embody the “working backward” philosophy, designing strategies and solutions prioritizing the end\-user’s experience.
* First Principles Thinking: You break down complex problems into fundamental truths, rebuilding smarter, simpler solutions.
* Relentless Iteration: You’re not afraid to experiment, learn, and refine rapidly to achieve better outcomes.
* Visionary Leadership: You inspire teams with bold goals, like transforming dealership service lanes or rethinking customer engagement models.
* Storytelling Mastery: You craft compelling narratives that highlight the value of myKaarma’s products and services, resonating with diverse stakeholders.


**We value diverse experiences and backgrounds, so we encourage you to apply if you meet some but not all of the listed qualifications.**
****Total Rewards at myKaarma****
**Benefits**
 At myKaarma, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that extends beyond the base salary. Our commitment to competitive compensation includes bonuses and benefits that support both personal and professional well\-being:
   

  

* Flexible Work Environment: We embrace a high\-performance, flexible structure that values freedom and responsibility. Our “Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled” model empowers teams to innovate and continuously improve using data\-driven insights.
* Health and Wellness: Comprehensive medical, life, and disability benefits.
* Time Off: Generous vacation time to recharge and balance life outside work.
* In\-Office Perks: Work in an agile office space with perks like ping pong and foosball to unwind and connect, and unlimited lunch, snacks, or refreshments on\-site.


 The starting salary range for this role is annually plus variable compensation, depending on experience and qualifications, reflecting our dedication to competitive industry compensation. Additional details about our Total Rewards package will be shared during recruitment.
   

  

****Our Commitment to Inclusion****
 At myKaarma, diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and inclusive workplace where every employee feels valued and empowered and can do meaningful work. Our mission to deliver exceptional solutions to our clients is strengthened by the unique contributions and perspectives of our team members from all backgrounds.
   

  

 As an equal opportunity employer, myKaarma prohibits any form of unlawful discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable laws in the regions where we operate.  may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. title: Technical Program Manager >
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Application
   

  

**Team:** 
 Core Platform
 **Reports to:** 
 Director of Engineering
   

  

**About The Company**
 At Redpin we simplify life's most important payments. Buying a new property overseas can be a stressful time, especially when it comes to moving your money. Through our Currencies Direct and TorFX brands we've been helping people do just that for over 25 years. With recent investment we're now on a mission to build a new range of digital products and services that will make moving money internationally for real estate purchases even easier.
   

  

 We're on a mission to become the solution for real estate payments everywhere. To do this, we are transitioning our business from a horizontal FX platform to a verticalized, embedded software company, as we look to the future and Redpin 2\.0\.
   

  

 As part of this mission, we're thrilled to announce we have opened a new office in Hyderabad!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will own the delivery of Redpin's most important cross\-functional business initiatives — the programs the company is betting on — and be accountable for the outcome, not just the plan.
   

  

 Success means bringing multiple teams into alignment on scope, dependencies, and timelines, holding that alignment as things change, and driving execution through to shipped. You'll operate across Engineering, Product, Operations, and the CTO's office, turning ambiguous, high\-stakes goals into a plan teams believe in and then landing it. When a program starts slipping from green to yellow to red, you're the one who sees it first and does what it takes to turn it back
   

  

 You'll do this as a nimble, async\-first operator — not by filling calendars with status meetings.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key cross\-functional initiatives across Core Platform, from planning to ship.
* Drive quarterly planning: shape goals with leadership, decompose initiatives, map dependencies, and align teams on scope and timelines.
* Maintain an honest RAG view of program health; detect risk early, escalate the right issues to the right people, and drive the actions that turn red/yellow back to green.
* Unblock teams — broker decisions, remove dependencies, and make pragmatic calls rather than logging problems and waiting.
* Manage risk and dependencies across teams and third parties (banking partners, payment rails, critical vendors).
* Keep leadership informed through crisp written updates that drive decisions without a meeting.


**What You’ll Need**
* Proven track record delivering complex, cross\-functional technical programs in a fast moving environment.
* Strong technical fluency — enough to earn engineers' trust, reason about architecture and trade\-offs, and make pragmatic decisions.
* Excellent written communication and stakeholder management across ICs, managers, Directors, Product, Operations, and executive leadership; strong persuasion and influence without authority.
* Sharp risk and escalation instincts — you recognise "yellow turning red" early and know how to intervene.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action; async\-first working style.
* Experience with quarterly/OKR planning and dependency management at scale


**Nice to have**
* Experience in payments, fintech, FX, or banking, and comfort where compliance and delivery intersect.
* Exposure to third\-party vendors, banking partners, or platform integrations.


**How We Work**
 Async\-first and pragmatic. We default to writing, meet only when a decision needs a room, and value judgement over process. We're not looking for a TPM who runs programs by the book or blocks progress with ceremony — we're looking for the person who is the reason initiatives ship.

 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function.  Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Department:** 
 Data Analytics and AI Solution \- Research \& Development / Platform Engineering
 



  





**About the Team** 




 You will be joining a dynamic, 200\-member strong technology organization, working directly within our specialized 50\-person Platform R\&D division. Our mission is to research and develop cutting\-edge AI solutions based on real\-world use cases gathered by our sales teams. We operate as an innovation engine: we build rapid Proofs of Concept (POCs) for our sales teams, and when a POC demonstrates high market demand, we transform it into a robust, deployable enterprise solution.
 



  





 Recent examples of our work include
 **Spark** 
 , a platform designed for intelligent document information extraction, and our
 **Company Data Platform** 
 , which uses a single company name to autonomously scrape, classify, and extract rich company profiles from the web.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a highly adaptable and imaginative
 **Junior Business Analyst** 
 who thrives in ambiguity. In this role, you will be the crucial bridge between abstract ideas and tangible technology. You will take one\-line statements and vague articulations from the sales team and translate them into concrete POC scopes. As products mature, you will expand those scopes into full\-fledged business requirements, leverage AI to generate HTML mockups, and work closely with our engineering teams to bring these AI\-native platforms to life.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Requirement Elicitation:** 
 Translate vague requests, one\-line problem statements, and high\-level sales needs into clear, actionable scopes for Proofs of Concept (POCs).

 Conduct deep\-dive analyses into specific business domains and problems to expand successful POCs into comprehensive, full\-scale platform requirements.
* **Rapid Prototyping:** 
 Utilize generative AI tools to create detailed HTML mockups that effectively communicate product vision, UI/UX flow, and application features to stakeholders and engineers.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner directly with UI (Angular) developers, Python engineers, and Database engineers (SQL \& NoSQL) to guide the product development lifecycle from mockup to a fully functional application.
* **System \& Workflow Design:** 
 Design sophisticated, AI\-native user interfaces and workflows that cater to background AI extractions, data processing, and human\-in\-the\-loop curation and validation.
* **Data Modeling Support:** 
 Collaborate with DB and backend engineers to ensure database schemas and Python services are perfectly aligned with business requirements and UI data consumption needs.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 



* **Analytical Thinking:** 
 Exceptional ability to dissect vague information, ask the right questions, and structure ambiguous concepts into logical requirements.
* **Technical Aptitude:** 
 Foundational understanding of how web applications work, including UI components, backend services (Python), and databases (both SQL and NoSQL).
* **Prototyping Skills:** 
 Familiarity with basic HTML/CSS and a strong willingness to use AI\-assisted tools to generate and modify technical mockups.
* **Communication:** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and business concepts to diverse audiences.
* **Workflow Mapping:** 
 Ability to visualize and document complex user journeys, especially those involving automated background processes and human review steps.
* An
 **undergraduate degree in B.E. / B.Tech** 
 combined with an
 **MBA** 
 from a premium institute (such as IIM, IIT, Great Lakes, or equivalent), and prior professional experience in Big 4 consulting, top\-tier financial firms, or leading analytical firms.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Natural Language Processing (NLP) concepts (e.g., data extraction, web scraping, classification).
* Basic familiarity with Angular or similar frontend frameworks.
* Experience in an Agile/Scrum R\&D or rapid prototyping environment.
